## 4. Detailed mirror-selfie otaku room scene

- **id**：553
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=553

### 描述

A very detailed Nano Banana prompt describing a female mirror selfie in a blue-toned otaku computer corner, with full specifications for character, environment, lighting, camera, and negative prompts.

### 示例图

![Detailed mirror-selfie otaku room scene](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1763889946850_689z0h_G23i3sJW0AASGUw.jpg)

### 提示词

```
### Scene
Mirror selfie in an otaku-style computer corner, blue color tone.

### Subject
* Gender expression: female
* Age: around 25
* Ethnicity: East Asian
* Body type: slim, with a defined waist; natural body proportions
* Skin tone: light neutral tone
* Hairstyle:
    * Length: waist-length hair
    * Style: straight with slightly curled ends
    * Color: medium brown
* Pose:
    * Stance: standing in a slight contrapposto pose
    * Right hand: holding a smartphone in front of her face (identity hidden)
    * Left arm: naturally hanging down alongside the torso
    * Torso: body leaning slightly back; waist and abdomen exposed
* Clothing:
    * Top: light blue cropped knit cardigan, top two buttons fastened; a blue French-style bra faintly visible
    * Bottom: denim ultra-short shorts, with a blue satin ribbon bow on each side of the hips
    * Socks: blue and white horizontal striped over-the-knee socks
    * Accessory: a blue cute mascot phone case

### Environment
* Description: bedroom computer corner seen through a wall-mounted mirror
* Furnishings:
    * White desk
    * Single monitor showing a soft blue wallpaper (no readable text)
    * Mechanical keyboard with white keycaps on a blue desk mat
    * Mouse on a small blue mouse pad
    * PC tower on the right side with blue case lighting
    * Three anime figures on or near the PC tower
    * A poster of a pagoda on the wall
    * Cat-shaped desk lamp with blue accents
    * A transparent glass of water
    * A tall green leafy plant by the window (on the left side of the frame)
* Color replacement: replace all originally pink elements (clothes and room decor) with blue tones (baby blue to sky blue/periwinkle blue).

### Lighting
* Light source: daylight coming from a large window on the left side of the camera, through sheer curtains
* Light quality: soft, diffused light
* White balance (K): 5200

### Camera
* Mode: smartphone rear camera shooting via the mirror (no portrait/bokeh mode)
* Equivalent focal length (mm): 26
* Distances (m):
    * Subject to mirror: 0.6
    * Camera to mirror: 0.5
* Exposure:
    * Aperture (f): 1.8
    * ISO: 100
    * Shutter speed (s): 0.01
    * Exposure compensation (EV): -0.3
* Focus: focus on the torso and shorts in the mirror image
* Depth of field: natural smartphone deep depth of field; background clearly visible with no artificial blur
* Composition:
    * Aspect ratio: 1:1
    * Crop: from the top of the head to mid-thigh; include the desk, monitor, PC tower, and plant in the frame
    * Angle: slightly high angle from the mirror’s point of view
    * Composition note: keep the subject centered; to avoid wide-angle edge distortion, have her stand a bit further away and crop to a square later.

### Negative prompts
* Any appearance of pink/magenta anywhere
* Beauty filters/over-smoothed skin; poreless skin look
* Exaggerated or distorted anatomy
* NSFW, see-through fabrics, wardrobe malfunctions
* Logos, brand names, or readable user interface text
* Fake portrait-mode blur, CGI/illustration feel
```

## 233. Photo Booth Strip Narrative Prompt for Nano Banana 2

- **id**：13291
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=13291

### 描述

A complex narrative prompt for Nano Banana 2 requiring the generation of two side-by-side photo booth strips (8 frames total) in black and white, depicting a story where one person gradually leaves their strip and appears in the other person's strip, emphasizing facial feature preservation and specific frame content.

### 示例图

![Photo Booth Strip Narrative Prompt for Nano Banana 2](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1775544741736_mcdaxr_HFOnj_ua8AAdHba.jpg)

### 提示词

```
CRITICAL: Preserve both people's facial features exactly as in the reference photos. Both must be clearly recognizable.

Create two vertical photo booth strips side by side on a dark red textured fabric background. Each strip has 4 square black-and-white frames stacked vertically with white borders.

The story: he gradually leaves HIS strip (right) and appears in HER strip (left).

LEFT STRIP:
Frame 1: woman ALONE, smiling at camera
Frame 2: couple TOGETHER — he has appeared next to her, they look at each other laughing
Frame 3: couple kissing, eyes closed
Frame 4: couple embracing, both smiling at camera

RIGHT STRIP:
Frame 1: man ALONE, smiling at camera
Frame 2: man ALONE, looking sideways toward her, as if about to leave his frame
Frame 3: the frame is almost empty — only a faint shadow or slight blur where he was, he has left
Frame 4: empty frame — just the photo booth background, no person, he is gone completely

All frames black-and-white, high contrast, slight film grain. Direct front flash, flat photo booth lighting. Both wear simple dark clothing. Tight framing — head and shoulders. Strips are separate, never merging.
```

- A person in a {argument name="real world coat color" default="grey"} coat walking with an umbrella

- The edges where puddle meets cobblestone show the transition between worlds
- Rain drops hitting the puddle surface create small circular ripples that briefly distort the fantasy world

5 Other Accessories: Beige ribbed knit leg warmers, loosely piled around the calves and ankles.

VII. Shooting Method
1 Overall Style: Realistic phone snapshot texture, close to daily social media photos, with a natural bedroom selfie atmosphere.
2 Camera Angle: Low angle, close to the bed surface, using a wide-angle phone perspective.
3 Image Type: Vertical composition, full-body casual selfie, foreground bedding takes up a significant proportion, exaggerated leg perspective.

3 Aesthetic Direction: Korean female celebrity aesthetic combined with a realistic bedroom snapshot feel.
4 Realism Requirements: Retain imperfect composition, messy bedding, wide-angle distortion, and harshness of the flash, making the image look more like a real photo rather than a deliberate pose.

• slightly worn edges

COMPOSITION

• soft museum lighting
• photographed like an art catalog

AVOID
real skin texture
photoreal pores

Create an Ultra-detailed, ratio 4:5, hyperrealistic full-body photograph of a stylish me posing on a modern city sidewalk under bright, direct midday sun. He wears a striking, slightly glossy crimson red faux leather jacket zipped halfway over a crisp white collared shirt. His trousers are wide-leg, cream-colored corduroy with visible texture. To his right, a cute chibi anime character version of himself, with a large head and big eyes, perfectly mirrors his pose and outfit, rendered with clean black line art and simple cell shading. The lighting is hard sunlight from the top-right, casting sharp, defined shadows on the light grey tiled pavement. The background consists of a modern building with large, greenish-tinted glass panels. Shot with a 35mm lens, f/5.6 aperture, creating sharp focus on the subject and graphics with a slightly soft background. The color science emphasizes high contrast between the crimson red, cream, and cool tones of the environment. Avoid any motion blur, unnatural skin textures, or distorted proportions. The integration of the graphic elements must be seamless and clean, without pixelation or rough edges.

The prompt strictly mandates 100% preservation of the subject's identity (face, proportions, features, age, hair) and specifies fixed parameters for the decor, composition (vertical full-length shot), lighting (harsh direct flash/spam style), attire (oversize white t-shirt, black pants), and pose (standing, hand touching hair, model posture).

Create a photorealistic lifestyle/editorial photo shoot of the « casual flash in a street café » type, using a provided photo of a person as a reference. The person's appearance must be strictly identical to the model: perfectly recognizable face (100%), same facial proportions and geometry, same shape of eyes, nose, and lips, same complexion, same age, same hairstyle, and same hairline. Do not modify the face, do not « enhance » it, and do not change the gender. The setting is fixed: an evening café/lounge area (interior), beige walls, a large window overlooking the dark night, a wooden bar counter along the window, simple furniture: black metal chairs, wooden tables. To the left, a large potted indoor plant. No readable signs, logos, or text on the walls or windows. The composition is fixed: a vertical full-length shot, the camera at chest height, the person standing slightly to the right of center. In the foreground, on the left, a black metal chair is placed on a white backpack adorned with a black graphic print (no readable text). The lighting is fixed: a powerful flash (direct camera flash), marked shadows on the wall and floor, a « spam » photo style, like that of a compact camera or an iPhone. The attire is also fixed: an oversize white t-shirt without a logo or inscription, wide black pants, white sneakers with black stripes (retro style), a belt, a chain, or keys at the waist (unbranded) are acceptable. The pose is fixed: the person is standing, relaxed, next to the chair, the body slightly turned three-quarters; the right hand is raised and touches the head/hair (palm on the nape of the neck), the left hand is lowered near the hip. The legs: one leg is extended, the other slightly bent, the heel raised, creating a model posture. The head is turned to the side (left), the gaze is not fixed on the lens, the expression is calm and confident, without a smile. Quality/Style: ultra-realistic, sharp focus on the face, slight depth of field, natural complexion, light grain, no retouching, glossy appearance. ## 1526. iPhone Aesthetic Prompt Generator Framework

- **id**：11055
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=11055

### 描述

This is a meta-prompt or system instruction designed to guide an LLM (like Nano Banana 2) to generate highly specific, structured JSON prompts for creating ultra-realistic AI influencers, simulating the optical characteristics and aesthetic of an iPhone Pro Max camera (e.g., 24mm, Deep Fusion, computational bokeh). The user must provide the scene description to trigger the JSON output.

### 示例图

![iPhone Aesthetic Prompt Generator Framework](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1772346659160_chqwxf_HCQU8qpa0AAod9b.jpg)

### 提示词

```
<role>
You're specialized in computational photography, specifically the optical characteristics of the iPhone 16/17 Pro Max sensor system. You translate human concepts into mathematically precise image generation prompts.
</role>

<cognitive_framework>
<principle name="Context Hunger">
If the user provides a vague concept (e.g., "girl at a cafe"), you must explicitly invent the missing environmental, lighting, and styling details to ensure a complete image.
</principle>
<principle name="The iPhone Aesthetic">
All outputs must strictly simulate high-end mobile photography.
- Focal Lengths: 24mm (Main), 13mm (Ultra Wide), or 77mm (Telephoto).
- Characteristics: "Apple ProRAW" color science, sharp details (Deep Fusion), computational bokeh (Portrait Mode), and Smart HDR dynamic range.
- Avoid: Anamorphic lens flares, exaggerated "cinema" bokeh, or vintage film grain (unless specified as a filter).
</principle>
<principle name="Imperfection is Realism">
To achieve "ultra-realism," you must inject terms describing unpolished reality: digital noise (not film grain), skin texture, slightly blown-out highlights (common in mobile), and natural "snapshot" framing.
</principle>
<principle name="JSON Precision">
Your output is a strict JSON object designed for programmatic use.
</principle>
</cognitive_framework>

<visual_analysis_reference>
The "Influencer Aesthetic" is defined by:
- Vibe: "Plandid" (planned candid), effortlessness, aspirational lifestyle.
- Lighting: Natural window light, golden hour, or "flash photography" (hard flash) for night shots.
- Framing: Vertical (9:16) native mobile aspect ratio, often selfies or point-of-view (POV).
</visual_analysis_reference>

<instructions>
1. Analyze the user's request for subject and mood.
2. Enrich the request using "iPhone Photography" constraints.
3. Format the output strictly as a JSON object with the following schema.
</instructions>

<json_schema>
{
  "meta_data": {
    "style": "iPhone Pro Max Photography",
    "aspect_ratio": "9:16"
  },
  "prompt_components": {
    "subject": "Detailed description of person, styling, pose (mirror selfie, 0.5x angle, etc.)",
    "environment": "Detailed background, location, social setting",
    "lighting": "Smart HDR lighting, natural source, or direct flash",
    "camera_gear": "iPhone 16 Pro Max, Main Camera 24mm f/1.78, or Ultra Wide 13mm",
    "processing": "Apple ProRAW, Deep Fusion, Shot on iPhone",
    "imperfections": "Digital noise, motion blur, authentic skin texture, screen reflection (if mirror)"
  },
  "full_prompt_string": "The combined, comma-separated string optimized for realistic mobile generation",
  "negative_prompt": "Standard negatives + 'professional camera, DSLR, bokeh balls, anamorphic, cinema lighting, studio lighting'"
}
</json_schema>

<task>
Await user description of the scene. Generate the JSON output immediately.
</task>
```

class ChocolateCrepeAd:
    def __init__(self):
        self.resolution = "8K_ULTRA_HD"
        self.frame_ratio = "9:16"  # Optimized for Social Media
        https://t.co/cI7K2nrLBL = "Hyper-Realistic / Professional Styling"

    def setup_scene(self):
        # Background & Environment
        self.surface = cr.Surface(material="Rustic Wooden Board", texture="Grainy")
        self.background = Bokeh(source="Vibrant Green Plants", blur_intensity=0.8)
        https://t.co/ci6mMG4fGy = NaturalLight(time="Warm Golden Hour", mood="Soft Cinematic")

        self.subject = cr.FoodItem(

                "filling": "Rich Glossy Chocolate-Hazelnut Spread"
            }
        )

    def apply_motion_effects(self):
        # Dynamic Elements
        FluidDynamics.add_drizzle(
            substance="Molten Chocolate",
            speed="Slow-Motion",
            behavior="Falling / Coating"
        )
        SteamParticles.emit(source=self.subject, opacity=0.3)
        
        # Camera Movement
        https://t.co/Oq1q7ViC4J = https://t.co/Wl1DQQj2RB(mode="Macro")
        https://t.co/Oq1q7ViC4J.path = ["Slow Pan", "Tilt", "Slight Rotation"]
        https://t.co/Oq1q7ViC4J.focus = "Gooey ends and creamy textures"

    def render_commercial(self):
        return self.setup_scene().apply_motion_effects().execute(fps=60)

Her expression is serene and slightly distant, with parted lips and eyes softly open. The entire frame is bathed in golden beige and sepia tones, evoking a nostalgic, painterly atmosphere. The lighting is natural and diffused, coming from a nearby window, casting a warm glow on her skin and illuminating the strands of hair that dance across the frame. The focus is soft, with a shallow depth of field that isolates the subject from the pale, creamy background. Post-processed in Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop: cinematic LUTs applied, warmth enhanced through split-toning (shadows in soft amber, highlights in cream), clarity reduced, and motion streaks refined with displacement layers and radial blur filters. A very subtle fine grain adds a filmic texture. Final mood: emotional, hazy, poetic. Style references: fine art portraiture, vintage editorial, and analog dream sequences. 4K ultra-resolution, no harsh contrasts, smooth gradients preserved.
```

Use the uploaded photos as the ONLY appearance standards: keep the faces of both people 1:1 (features, proportions, age, skin tone, hair color/length), without changing their appearance even by 1%, without enhancing, without facial retouching. Lighting: hard flash to the forehead (direct on-camera flash), strong shadows and sharp contrast, "snapshot" aesthetic, bright highlights on the skin and fabric, darker background. Film style: real film grain, slight color shift, light green/blue cast, soft blur at the edges, subtle vignette, dust/scratches, analog sharpness. Realism: genuine leather (pore detail), natural hair, textured sweatshirt fabric. Aspect ratio 3:4.
```

## 2185. Seamless Cinematic Japanese Food Video Prompt

- **id**：10056
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=10056

### 描述

A comprehensive, cinematic prompt used to generate a 4-cut video focused on Japanese cuisine, emphasizing ASMR elements, smooth transitions (match cuts/pans), warm lighting, and a minimalist piano soundtrack with Japanese instrument accents. The prompt was used for both image generation (Nano Banana Pro) and video generation (Kling 3.0 Omni).

### 示例图

![Seamless Cinematic Japanese Food Video Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1771050479260_e17orq_HBCB8_-bYAAludD.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Generate a cinematic video focused on Japanese cuisine, consisting of four seamlessly connected cuts.

The first cut should be a close-up, carefully capturing cooking sounds, the rhythm of the knife, and the movement of hands touching the ingredients, starting with ASMR-like sound design that emphasizes steam and ingredient textures. The camera should use shallow depth of field and slow motion to naturally guide the viewer from the hands to the woman's gestures, showing her cuteness through small movements like subtle surprise or a gentle smile. Transition smoothly from here using match cuts or pans.

The second cut is a mid-shot of plating, beautifully capturing the movement of chopsticks and the moment ingredients are placed on the dish, emphasizing the delicate sounds of the dish and ingredients resonating, highlighting charm through carefulness and affection.

The subsequent cut uses an overhead composition to show the overall view of the finished dish, with the camera slowly zooming in, capturing the moment the woman takes a bite in a close-up, delicately capturing her breathing and subtle reactions to invite viewer empathy.

The final part connects to a warm interaction across the table, using a soft pan and crossfade to leave a lingering impression, subtly mixing laughter and fragments of conversation to express intimacy. The color tone should be filmic and warm-leaning, with natural lighting that keeps highlights gently suppressed. The music should be minimalist piano with Japanese instrument accents, and sound effects should carefully mix cooking and eating sounds to enhance realism. The overall tempo should be relaxed, prioritizing the natural connection of each cut's end to the next beginning through sound and movement.
```

## 2236. Character Generation Prompt (Step 1)

- **id**：9955
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=9955

### 描述

The first step in a multi-step process, this prompt is designed to generate a high-resolution (4K recommended) image of a main character, focusing on composition, high-contrast lighting, and detailed facial features of a young Japanese woman with a K-pop idol aesthetic.

### 示例图

![Character Generation Prompt (Step 1)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770964577240_tfxnoo_HA9j2KxboAEwB_P.jpg)

### 提示词

```
I. Composition & Spatial Layout
1.Framing & Scale: The subject occupies approximately 60–70% of the frame height. Leave at least 30% of the frame height as empty space above the head. Both left and right sides retain clearly visible empty wall space.
2.Visual Focus: A minimal, uncluttered background designed to strongly emphasize facial structure, eye expression, and skin quality.

II. Lighting & Shadow Style
1.Key Light: Intense natural daylight, side-backlit with a slight reverse angle, cool-toned, producing extreme high-contrast separation between highlights and shadows.
2.Light Characteristics: Dense, hard-edged leaf-shadow patterns projected across the wall and the subject’s body and face. Shadow edges are razor-sharp with extremely narrow penumbra.
3.Highlight Control: Large areas of the background are deliberately overexposed while retaining faint surface texture, creating a glowing, almost blinding spatial atmosphere.

III. Subject Appearance (Face & Hair — Reference Applied)
1.Facial Structure:
A young Japanese woman in her 20s with a refined V-shaped face, sharp jawline, and high-definition facial contours. Overall facial balance is elegant yet striking, with high visual impact.
2.Skin Quality:
Porcelain-toned Japanese skin with a cool undertone. Ultra-smooth, luminous texture enhanced by strong contrast lighting while retaining realistic skin detail.
3.Eyes & Expression:
・Large, sharp fox-shaped eyes
・Confident gaze directed straight into the camera
・Expression carries a cool, playful, slightly teasing energy
・K-pop idol–inspired eyeliner with clearly emphasized aegyosal
・Overall expression is controlled, calm, and subtly provocative rather than smiling
4.Mouth:
Relaxed lips with a subtle, effortless smirk. Glossy gradient lips with a refined sheen, never exaggerated.
5.Hair Style:
Long, sleek, straight black hair reaching the waist, with perfectly straight, neatly trimmed Japanese bangs. Hair finish is glossy, clean, and fashion-forward, moving minimally in the light.
6.Makeup Style:
High-contrast K-pop idol–inspired makeup. Clean base, sculpted facial structure, cool-toned color balance, no warm or heavy blush.
7.Accessories (Minimal):
・Small gold pendant necklace
・Small gold hoop earrings
・Minimalist tattoo on the left inner forearm

IV. Clothing
・Cropped pure-white bandeau-style tube top
・Body-hugging but not tight, exposing the waist
・Fabric remains clean and structured, no wrinkles distracting from silhouette
```

A detailed video prompt generated by Freepik's assistant (GPT-5) based on an image from Nano Banana Pro, used to create a short film sequence with Kling 3.0. The prompt outlines three scenes focusing on smooth camera movements, close-ups of morning rituals, and a cinematic conclusion.

![Morning Routine Video Generation using Kling 3.0](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770964577252_29693p_HA7BRmUaMAASstR.jpg)

![Morning Routine Video Generation using Kling 3.0](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770964577426_90m0yz_HA7BRKBagAAapve.jpg)

Scene 1
Use a smooth dolly shot to approach the window, transitioning from a long shot to a medium shot of the subject taking a deep breath in the morning light. Focus on subtle movements like relaxing the shoulders and finger reactions, creating an adorable atmosphere with distant natural sounds (birds chirping, wind) layered with delicate piano music. Crossfade to a close-up where the window light reflects on the fingertips.

Scene 2
Use close-ups focusing on steaming cups and small objects to rhythmically follow the hand movements (lifting the cup, stirring with a spoon, etc.). Use a combination of slow motion and light time-lapse to express warmth and innocence, layering sound effects like breathing and small laughs. The steam fills the screen and dissolves, leading to the next scene.

Scene 3
The camera pulls back to show the whole scene, concluding with the light movement of the subject ready to go out. Show the lingering atmosphere through the rhythm of steps and hand gestures, concluding cinematically with a backlit silhouette and soft color tones. The music gently fades out, leaving the lingering feeling of everyday life.

A "gritty" (raw/grainy) mirror selfie taken with an iPhone late at night in a female dormitory. She is sitting on the edge of her bed, slightly leaning forward.

Her posture is relaxed and natural (unposed): one leg bent, the other hanging naturally, shoulders loose, and the body slightly angled due to the mirror's perspective. Head subtly tilted to the viewer's right, the face dominates almost the entire frame, shoulders rounded forward, and the body leaning slightly towards the camera to achieve that classic cozy night-time selfie compression.

The right hand (viewer's left side) is raised directly in front of the face, at chin or mouth level, with the palm clearly facing the camera, performing a prominent peace sign / V-sign gesture:

The index and middle fingers are fully extended and well separated (an angle of ~60–70° between them).

The ring and pinky fingers are fully bent, tightly pressed, and held flat by the thumb.

The thumb firmly anchors the bent fingers, being clearly visible as it presses against them.

The fingers point slightly upwards and forwards (not perfectly vertical, with a soft natural tilt).

Hand positioned centrally, very close to the face; the fingertips are approximately at the level of the lips or nose, creating a strong foreground element.

The left hand is not visible, completely out of frame.

Relaxed and casual torso posture: shoulders slightly hunched forward, neck gently stretched towards the lens, the typical hunched pose of a low-light bedroom selfie.

The lighting comes solely from the bedroom ceiling lamp, raw and imperfect: direct phone flash reflected in the mirror, blown-out highlights on the skin and fabric, harsh shadows, uneven exposure, visible grain, slight motion blur, flash flares, and reflections within reflections.

 * Camera Style: Shot on a high-end digital camera (35mm lens), f/2.8 aperture for a slight soft-focus blur on the distant background, sharp focus on the subjects' faces, 8k resolution, cinematic color grading.
Technical Observations

It uses 'Identity Lock' and 'Expression Sync' to enforce 1:1 replication of facial geometry and expression from external reference images (A and B). It details the outfit (rib-knit mini-dress), anatomical volume (hyper-defined hourglass), and background integrity (pixel-perfect inventory of a domestic apartment setting).

```
(9:16). Portrait orientation. Raw high-fidelity photograph, iPhone 17 Pro simulation, 24mm wide-angle focal length, f/2.4 aperture for total structural depth, authentic digital grain, mirror-selfie perspective.

[Subject & Identity Locking]

Identity Lock: Absolute inheritance of all facial geometry, epidermal characteristics, ocular structure, and natural hair color/texture directly from Reference Image A. The AI must perform a 1:1 pixel-mapping of the subject's identity from Image A into the target scene.
Bio-Fidelity: Epidermal physics featuring visible micro-pores, fine vellus hair along the jawline, and satin-finish hydration on the T-zone, maintaining the exact skin-tone profile inherited from Image A.
Expression Sync: Expression Lock—replicate the mirror-selfie gaze through the lens, specific pouty lip tension, and soft tension of the facial muscles from Reference Image B.
[Outfit & Physicality] (CASE B - Standard Fashion)

Technical Description: High-tensile rib-knit mini-dress in {argument name="dress color" default="deep chocolate brown"} with a mock-neck collar and short sleeves. Hemline at upper-thigh geometry.
Textile Architecture: Visible vertical ribbing texture; material-to-skin tension showing realistic bunching at the waist. Paired with checkered-pattern comfort slides.
Anatomical Volume: Hyper-defined S-curve silhouette; maximum anatomical emphasis on the waist-to-hip ratio and leg definition; apply the 20% over-description rule for "Hyper-defined hourglass geometry" to counteract model bias.
Accessories: Transparent clear-frame optical glasses; long square-tip manicured nails; a small luxury monogram-texture leather handbag held in the left hand. Blue-cased smartphone held for the selfie.
[Pose & Interaction]

Geometry: Full-body standing mirror selfie pose. Right arm raised for the phone; left arm at the side holding the handbag. Subject is centered with a slight hip-pop to emphasize the silhouette.
Articulation: Precise finger-joint articulation on the smartphone and the bag handle; realistic skeletal alignment of the shoulders and neck.
[Environment & Lighting]

Atmosphere: Casual domestic interior apartment setting; soft diffused 4000K neutral-warm overhead lighting.
Background Integrity: Pixel-perfect inventory of wood-plank flooring; white interior doors (one featuring a {argument name="sticker detail" default="Hello Kitty sticker"}); a kitchen breakfast bar with a dark wooden bar stool; a pink handbag hanging in the mid-ground; and miscellaneous household items on the counter.
Shadow Ray-Tracing: Natural ambient occlusion in the garment folds; soft shadows cast by the subject onto the floor; realistic mirror-plane reflection with accurate depth and light-bounce from the background elements.

One hand is gracefully touching her neck, showing a statement ring. Moody, dramatic shadows, 8k resolution, shot on 35mm lens, fashion editorial style."
>
Breakdown of Details
| Element | Description |
|---|---|
| Lighting | Saturated red monochromatic lighting with high contrast (Chiaroscuro effect). |
| Technical Effect | Shutter Drag / Motion Blur: The "ghosting" effect behind the head suggests movement during a slow exposure. |
| Subject | A woman with fair skin, freckles, and wavy {argument name="hair color" default="ginger/auburn"} hair. |
| Wardrobe | A minimalist, elegant black dress with a plunging neckline that contrasts sharply against the red background. |
| Composition | Medium shot, centered, with a soft-focus vignette that draws attention to the face and hands. |
Tips for Customizing
 * To change the mood: Replace "deep red" with "electric blue" or "neon emerald" for a different vibe.
 * To change the model: You can specify "shorter hair," "different ethnicity," or "alternative clothing" while keeping the "motion blur" and "monochromatic light" tags to maintain the style.

## 2945. Four-Angle Cinematic Panel Composition

- **id**：8767
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=8767

### 描述

A complex prompt designed to generate a single cinematic image divided into four horizontal panels, each showing the same scene and subject from a different camera angle: bird’s-eye, side close-up, extreme close-up, and medium wide back shot. This is intended for high-end editorial film-strip compositions.

### 示例图

![Four-Angle Cinematic Panel Composition](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770100869316_3jmgr2_HALVK9ybUAAwAG_.jpg)

![Four-Angle Cinematic Panel Composition](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770100869337_1vafo0_HALVK32a8AAW243.jpg)

![Four-Angle Cinematic Panel Composition](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770100869469_n0tslw_HALVLKkbMAAnKr3.jpg)

![Four-Angle Cinematic Panel Composition](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770100870972_1wvoet_HALVK97aAAAQhRT.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create a single cinematic image divided into four horizontal panels, each panel representing a different camera angle of the same scene and subject.
All panels must be visually cohesive in lighting, color grading, and atmosphere.
Top panel – BIRD’S-EYE SHOT:
A top-down overhead view, perfectly vertical camera angle, emphasizing spatial layout and geometry.
Second panel – SIDE CLOSE-UP SHOT:
A close-up shot from the side profile, shallow depth of field, focusing on facial or object details with cinematic compression.
Third panel – EXTREME CLOSE-UP:
An extreme close-up capturing fine textures and micro details, filling the frame almost abstractly.
Bottom panel – MEDIUM WIDE BACK SHOT:
A medium-wide shot from behind the subject, showing posture and environment, cinematic framing, strong sense of depth.
Clean horizontal separations between panels, editorial film-strip composition, high-end cinematic still, consistent subject identity across all panels.
```

A prompt designed to generate an image of a woman in a 'Modern Bohemian' and 'Street Chic' all-denim outfit, featuring a cropped jacket and mini-shorts embroidered with Hamsa symbols, captured in a playful 'over-the-shoulder' pose at an outdoor event near a foosball table.

![Modern Bohemian Street Chic Denim Look Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769841122343_5qpl80_G_5Dir-WoAIMHmI.jpg)

```
General Ambiance and Character Style
Style: The character (same woman at the attached reference images) is wearing an all-denim ensemble that reflects a wonderful mix of "Modern Bohemian" and "Street Chic" styles.

Ambiance: The setting appears to be an event space or the background of an outdoor party. The character is standing at a foosball table, taking a break from the game to look back over her shoulder directly at the camera. The presence of other people and a production crew (a microphone boom can be spotted above) suggests this might be a film or photoshoot set.

Detailed Appearance and Pose
Pose: Standing sideways to the table, the character holds one of the foosball handles. With a slight twist of her body, she delivers a classic "over-the-shoulder" gaze that is both playful and assertive.

Hair and Makeup: Her long, light-brown hair flows naturally over her shoulders. Her makeup is very fresh and "glowy"; the highlighter on her cheekbones particularly shimmers in the daylight.

Outfit: * Top: She is wearing a cropped, long-sleeved denim jacket. The jacket features "Hand of Fatima" (Hamsa) embroideries—a protective symbol in Middle Eastern culture—along with colorful bead details, especially on the shoulder.

Bottom: She wears matching, very form-fitting denim mini-shorts. The back pockets also feature the same Hamsa embroidery and colorful stone embellishments, adding a mystic and artistic flair to the outfit.

Surrounding People and Details
Other Characters: On the opposite side of the table, looking at the main character with a smile, is another woman wearing a beige spaghetti-strap dress (resembling model Chrissy Teigen). To the left, the back of a man in a grey t-shirt—the character’s opponent in the game—is visible.

Table Detail: Resting on the edge of the foosball table is an icy drink in a metallic mug (likely a Moscow Mule cocktail), which reinforces the cheerful and relaxed mood of the setting.

## 3208. Hyper-Real Multi-Arm Professional Portrait

- **id**：8380
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=8380

### 描述

A complex, structured prompt template designed to generate a hyper-realistic studio portrait of a person in a specific profession, using a reference photo for identity consistency. The key feature is the creation of a 'multi-arm' illusion (6-8 arms) holding profession-relevant tools, set against a topic-matched colored backdrop with high-end commercial studio lighting.

### 示例图

![Hyper-Real Multi-Arm Professional Portrait](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769841132518_nuwk37_G_6ASt9WUAABbdR.jpg)

### 提示词

```
**[USER_PHOTO]** **[{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}]**

Create a hyper-real, studio portrait using [USER_PHOTO] as the exact identity reference (same face, hairstyle, skin texture, and age). Depict the person as a confident [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] sitting casually on a modern white ergonomic office chair, legs crossed, centered in frame. Add a stylized “multi-arm” illusion (6–8 arms total) radiating behind the torso like a modern Shiva/Vishnu-inspired silhouette, but photorealistic: each extra arm must have correct anatomy, believable joints, tendons, skin pores, and natural shadowing; no warped fingers.

PROPS (must be profession-relevant): Automatically choose and place different tools that a real [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] would use, one per hand/arm, all clearly readable and accurate in design. Examples of categories: primary tool, secondary tool, communication device, measurement/diagnostic tool, accessory, and a “hero” prop. Keep one real smartphone in the main/front hand. Avoid generic random objects—every prop must logically belong to [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}]. If [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] is digital/tech: include items like laptop, tablet, camera/monitor, light meter, stylus, keyboard, mic, etc. If [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] is medical: stethoscope, clipboard, otoscope, syringe (safe/clinical), etc. If [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] is culinary: chef knife, tongs, plating tweezers, recipe tablet, etc. (Always match [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}].)

BACKGROUND COLOR (topic-matched): Use a seamless paper studio backdrop with a single dominant color that matches the profession theme (e.g., warm mustard for creative/media, cool teal for healthcare, graphite/steel for engineering, rich olive for outdoors, deep burgundy for luxury). The color should complement skin tones and wardrobe. Add subtle gradient falloff and soft bounce for depth (no flat background).

LIGHTING & SET: High-end commercial studio look. One large soft key light from camera-left, controlled fill from right, crisp rim light to separate subject, and realistic specular highlights on props. Include a large circular silver reflector disk behind the subject (partially visible) for visual punch. Add a subtle shadow on the floor consistent with light direction.

WARDROBE & STYLING: Outfit must be believable for a top-tier [{argument name="profession" default="PROFESSION"}] (clean, modern, slightly stylized), with texture detail (fabric weave, seams). Add minimal accessories (watch/bracelet) that feel premium. Expression: focused, slightly intense, “in the zone.”

COMPOSITION & CAMERA: Full-body vertical portrait (4:5), 50mm lens look, eye-level camera, sharp focus on face, shallow depth of field but props still readable. Ultra-detailed skin, natural color grading, high dynamic range, crisp micro-contrast.

REALISM RULES: No cartoon, no CGI look. No extra faces, no duplicated heads. Hands must be anatomically correct (5 fingers), no melted objects, no unreadable text logos unless naturally present. Keep the scene clean and premium.
```

A detailed, structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to create a comical, anime-style infographic showing the infinite loop of a week, from the despair of Monday to the brief joy of the weekend, using a 7-segment circular pizza-cut layout while strictly maintaining character consistency from a reference image.

### 示例图

![Infographic prompt for 'Monday to Sunday' infinite loop manga](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769841148842_xua1xc_G_5sN1RbEAADF7D.jpg)

![Infographic prompt for 'Monday to Sunday' infinite loop manga](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769841148758_9h4rw3_G-9LgxnXQAAzOru.jpg)

### 提示词

```
[Character Reference Specification]
Must use the character from the reference image.
Must depict the same person in all panels.
Facial features, hairstyle, eye shape, and atmosphere must be perfectly consistent.
Changing the person, face, or hairstyle is prohibited.
Clothing may change for each day of the week, but the character itself must be the same.
Even if deformed, the character must be instantly recognizable as the person in the reference image.

[Overall Concept]
An anime illustration representing one week from Monday to Sunday,
in a perfectly circular shape.

[Composition/Layout]
・The entire circle must be divided into exactly 7 pizza-cut segments.
・6 or 12 divisions are prohibited.
・Exactly 7 equal sectors.
・Infographic-style layout.
・All 7 panels must connect naturally.

[Order of Days (Strictly Enforced - Clockwise)]
MONDAY → TUESDAY → WEDNESDAY → THURSDAY → FRIDAY → SATURDAY → SUNDAY → returns to MONDAY

[Circulation Expression]
・Place a thick circular arrow on the outer circumference of the circle.
・Clockwise direction.
・Emphasize that the week repeats infinitely.

[Character Design]
・Comical anime character with strong deformation.
・Chibi-style body shape.
・Large head and small body.
・Short limbs.
・Expressions are extreme and gag-oriented.
・Cute and exaggerated reactions.

[Text Rules]
・Only English day names are placed in each panel:
"MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY",
"FRIDAY", "SATURDAY", "SUNDAY".
・No dialogue, speech bubbles, or Japanese text whatsoever.
・Day names must be bold, easy to read, and without distortion.
・Placed along the shape of each panel.

[Depiction of Each Day]

MONDAY:
Deformed office worker (OL) in a suit.
Messy hair, dead eyes.
Holding two large coffees.

TUESDAY:
Working silently on a computer.
Surrounded by a mountain of documents taller than herself.

WEDNESDAY:
Working late overtime.
Dark office, night view outside the window.
Slumped posture, utterly exhausted.

THURSDAY:
Comical expression of the soul leaving the mouth.
A transparent, cute soul floats up from the body.
Depicting extreme fatigue as a gag.

FRIDAY:
High-tension expression.
Taking off her jacket,
Holding a large beer mug overflowing with foam.
Festive atmosphere.

SATURDAY:
Out happily with friends in casual clothes.
Energetic pose, jumping.
Bright and lively atmosphere.

SUNDAY:
Lying down on the bed as if collapsing.
The word "MONDAY" is visible on the smartphone screen.
Exaggerated despair.

[Art Style/Quality]
・Comical anime style with strong deformation.
・Thick line art.
・Simple shading.
・Bright and pop color scheme.
・Expressions are very easy to understand.
・High-quality illustration.

[Negative Prompts]
・Realistic style, photorealistic expression.
・Changes in character's face or hairstyle.
・Composition other than 7 divisions.
・Disruption of the day order.
・Japanese day names.
・Dialogue, speech bubbles.
・Distortion or collapse of text.
・Square panel division.
```

## 3274. Cinematic Portrait of Subject Floating High Above Clouds

- **id**：8152
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=8152

### 描述

An intense, highly restrictive prompt designed to create a surreal, cinematic photograph of a subject floating weightlessly high above a cloud layer. It emphasizes strict identity preservation from an uploaded photo, ultra-realistic natural lighting, high altitude setting with storm clouds, and specific camera/realism constraints to achieve a dramatic yet calm, minimalist composition.

### 示例图

![Cinematic Portrait of Subject Floating High Above Clouds](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769754980086_t2aj7o_G_2bWBRaoAESb-T.jpg)

### 提示词

```
TASK: Use the subject from the uploaded photo as the exact person in the final image.  SUBJECT RULES (STRICT): - Use the uploaded photo as the sole reference for the person. - Preserve the subject’s identity, facial features, body proportions, hairstyle, clothing, and overall likeness. - Do NOT change the subject’s face, age, gender, or identity. - Do NOT stylize the subject into a cartoon or illustration. - The subject must remain fully photorealistic.  SCENE & COMPOSITION: Create a surreal, cinematic photograph of the subject suspended in mid-air, floating as if gently falling, frozen in perfect stillness high above the Earth. The subject’s body appears weightless with a natural falling posture. Clothing and loose elements subtly ripple in the wind.  ENVIRONMENT: - High-altitude sky scene above the cloud layer. - Overcast yet luminous sky with towering storm clouds breaking apart. - Soft, realistic sunlight rays piercing through gaps in the clouds. - Natural volumetric light beams and atmospheric depth. - Subtle cloud vapor and mist drifting around the subject. - A distant commercial passenger airplane appears in the background, small in scale, flying horizontally through the clouds. - The airplane must remain far behind the subject and never overlap or distract from them. - A few birds are also present at varying distances, closer than the airplane, with slight motion blur to reinforce depth and scale.  LIGHTING & COLOR: - Ultra-realistic natural lighting. - Cool blues and soft whites dominate the palette. - Warm golden highlights from sunlight striking cloud edges and parts of the subject. - High dynamic range with realistic contrast.  CAMERA & REALISM: - Cinematic photography style. - Realistic depth of field (no artificial or extreme blur). - Correct perspective and scale consistent with high altitude aviation. - No fantasy lighting, no glowing outlines, no surreal distortions beyond the floating effect.  MOOD & STYLE: - Dramatic yet calm. - Minimalist composition. - Strong sense of altitude, silence, and suspension. - Hyper-realistic weather, clouds, and atmospheric detail. - Looks like a high-end cinematic still, not digital art.  HARD RULES: - Do NOT change the subject’s identity or pose beyond floating. - Do NOT add text, logos, UI, or watermarks. - Do NOT introduce sci-fi or fantasy elements. - Keep everything physically believable and grounded in realism.
```

### 描述

A highly detailed prompt for generating a hyper-realistic, chaotic, and energetic night-time photo simulating an unedited iPhone rear-camera flash aesthetic. It specifies a subject at a racing circuit, harsh head-on flash lighting creating abrupt shadow falloff, wide-angle distortion, and visible noise/grain, aiming for a spontaneous, unposed look identical to a reference image.

### 示例图

![Hyper-Realistic Candid Night Race Photo with iPhone Flash Aesthetic](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769755010292_xv2sd7_G_2O2Jpb0AA_pUE.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Subject: Person in the image

Create a 3:4 hyper-realistic candid night-time event photo in an unedited iPhone rear-camera flash look. Shot handheld at chest-to-face height, close to the Subject, with a wide-angle feel (≈24–26mm equivalent), slight edge distortion, and deep depth-of-field keeping the Subject, nearby crowd, and racetrack background readable.

Vertical medium-close framing from waist to slightly above the head. The Subject stands near a railing at a racing circuit, body angled slightly sideways, one arm bent casually near the railing, the other relaxed. Framing feels rushed and instinctive—slightly off-center, with background elements overlapping and partially cropped.

Direct on-camera flash fires head-on, strongly illuminating the Subject and creating harsh highlights on skin, hair, and racing jacket, with abrupt shadow falloff behind the shoulders. Stadium lights, LED screens, and signage appear in the background as blown highlights and soft bokeh points. Low-level noise and grain remain visible in darker crowd and structure areas.

Phone-style exposure prioritizes the Subject, lifting highlights and compressing shadows. Mild computational sharpening appears along hair strands, jacket seams, printed logos, and facial contours.

The Subject’s expression is alert and slightly distracted, mouth gently parted, gaze directed off-frame as if reacting to live action nearby. The moment feels mid-event and unposed.

The Subject wears a white-and-dark racing-style jacket with visible motorsport branding and patches over a fitted inner top, showing structured fabric, subtle sheen, and natural folds. A thin necklace catches small flash highlights at the collarbone, with jeans and a belt visible at the waist.

The environment is a crowded night racing circuit with railings, spectators, sponsor signage, LED screens, lighting rigs, and structural beams. The background feels busy, noisy, and energetic, adding visual clutter and motion.

The image should feel like a spontaneous iPhone flash photo taken during a live racing event—chaotic, energetic, and human. No cinematic lighting, no editorial posing, no beauty retouching.

Do not change the Subject’s facial features or proportions. The Subject must look 1000% identical to the reference image.

## 3432. Alexander McQueen Sneaker Commercial Grid Prompt (3x3)

- **id**：7963
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=7963

### 描述

A highly structured prompt for Gemini Nano Banana Pro to create a 3x3 commercial grid focusing on Alexander McQueen men's luxury sneakers. It defines nine unique visual concepts while strictly enforcing product consistency, lighting, and a high-end editorial aesthetic suitable for luxury fashion advertising.

### 示例图

![Alexander McQueen Sneaker Commercial Grid Prompt (3x3)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769668517208_7c2eeo_G_uOL8mbAAEHFtE.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create a 3x3 grid for a high-end commercial marketing campaign, centered around Alexander McQueen men's luxury sneakers.

Each frame should present a unique visual concept while maintaining perfect product consistency across all nine images.

Grid Concepts (one per cell):

1. 'Iconic Hero Shot': Eye-level side view on a dark, glossy pedestal, emphasizing the signature oversized sole.

2. 'Extreme Macro Detail': Close-up of the heel or stitching, highlighting the top-tier leather texture and the 'Alexander McQueen' logo embossing.

3. 'Dynamic Interaction': The shoe stepping onto a surface, creating a subtle and elegant splash effect of black liquid or marble powder.

4. 'Minimalist Sculptural Feel': The shoe artistically balanced on a geometric concrete or marble block, emphasizing the architectural design.

5. 'Floating Lightness': The shoe suspended in the air with dynamic hanging laces, conveying supreme comfort and lightness.

6. 'Sensory Texture': A tactile atmosphere shot focusing on the contrast between the velvet or smooth leather upper and a rough stone texture.

7. 'Monochromatic Luxury': A color-block scene where the background perfectly matches the shoe's accent color, creating a bold editorial look.

8. 'Deconstructed Craftsmanship': An abstract arrangement of raw materials (leather swatches, rubber textures) surrounding the shoe, symbolizing high-quality construction.

9. 'Surreal Fusion': The shoe integrated into a surreal, dreamlike landscape, blending realism with high fashion.

Visual Rules:
* 'Subject': Alexander McQueen men's oversized sneakers.
* 'Consistency': The shoe's shape, proportion, sole thickness, logo placement, and typography must be 100% accurate.
* 'No Distortion': No deformation of the signature sole or branding.
* 'Separation': Clear separation between the shoe and the background.

Lighting and Style:
* Soft, controlled studio lighting with dramatic rim light to highlight the shoe's silhouette.
* Subtle highlights on the leather, deep realistic shadows under the sole.
* High dynamic range, 8K resolution, ultra-sharp focus.
* Editorial luxury fashion advertising aesthetic (Vogue/GQ style).
* Color Palette: Minimalist, monochromatic, metallic, and deep matte tones.

Overall Vibe:
* Modern, sophisticated, visually coherent.
* High-end commercial campaign for a luxury fashion brand.
* Surreal, cinematic, refined, and aspirational.
```

Use the attached reference images as the handwriting style guide (especially the second image with handwriting samples). Create a single line of Japanese handwritten text on clean white paper. Written with a fine gel pen / fineliner (0.3–0.4mm look), thin and light strokes, mostly monoline (no brush or marker look). Match a stylish, airy, feminine handwriting feel: soft curves, light touch, and a slightly right-leaning slant.Add clear personality through noticeable character size variation (some characters 10–25% larger/smaller), irregular spacing, and a gentle upward baseline from left to right. Add elongated entry and exit strokes (long, tapered starts/tails) on a few characters—especially the first character, any elongated/extended marks in the text, and the final character—while keeping everything readable.Write exactly this text: "{argument name="text to write" default="The true chocolate tasted like an adult's."}" No extra text, no borders, no logos, no underline, no decorative swoosh lines. High resolution, sharp thin ink lines, minimal paper texture.
Negative:
brush pen, calligraphy, shodo, marker, thick strokes, bold ink, heavy pressure, paintbrush, blocky lettering, uniform character size, perfect spacing, perfectly straight baseline, printed font, typeset, outline font, extra words, watermark, frame, stamps, underline, swoosh line, doodles
Extra:
Keep strokes thin; create expressiveness mainly with size/spacing/baseline and tapered stroke ends, not thickness.Increase character size contrast and spacing irregularity, but keep legibility.
```

## 3493. Variable Fisheye POV Wildlife Prompt

- **id**：7859
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=7859

### 描述

A highly detailed, variable-driven prompt template designed to generate raw, hyper-realistic POV wildlife photographs using a fisheye lens effect, simulating an action camera like a GoPro. The example provided is for an Arctic Fox.

### 示例图

![Variable Fisheye POV Wildlife Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769581953958_t1sw1m_G_dfDa6WUAAZFPV.jpg)

![Variable Fisheye POV Wildlife Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769581953955_c03wzc_G_dfBkBW8AAYllS.jpg)

![Variable Fisheye POV Wildlife Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769581954672_74al5n_G_dfCV3W8AEdTjw.jpg)

![Variable Fisheye POV Wildlife Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769581955525_2m9nu3_G_dfEMJXYAAnbhM.jpg)

### 提示词

```
DIRECTIVE:
Generate a raw, hyper-realistic POV wildlife photograph shot on an action camera (GoPro style).

SUBJECT ({VAR_SUBJECT}):
A {argument name="subject" default="pristine white Arctic Fox"} captured at intimate, point-blank range.
Pose: The {VAR_SUBJECT} is extremely close to the lens, inspecting it curiously. This creates the signature wide-angle facial distortion: a prominent {argument name="facial feature" default="cute wet black nose, massive fluffy ears, and curious whiskers"}, massive head proportions, and intense eye contact.
The Eyes: {argument name="eyes description" default="Large, striking golden-brown eyes"}. They must feature a sharp reflection of the {VAR_REFLECTION}, conveying wild intelligence.
Texture: The skin or fur details are incredibly high-definition, featuring {VAR_TEXTURE_DETAILS}.

ENVIRONMENT ({VAR_BIOME}):
The backdrop is {VAR_LOCATION_DESC}.
Terrain: Sharp contrast between {VAR_TERRAIN_DETAILS}.
Atmosphere: {VAR_ATMOSPHERE}. The air feels distinct and immersive. The background stretches out endlessly due to the wide focal length.

TECHNICAL SPECS (THE GOPRO LOOK):
Lens: 16mm Ultra-Wide Angle (Fisheye effect).
Focus: Macro Wide. The focus is locked sharply on the subject's eyes and nose, while the distant horizon fades into a soft, atmospheric blur (Depth of Field).
Lighting: {VAR_LIGHTING}. Soft, diffuse, shadowless ambient light that enhances the subject against the terrain.
Post-Processing: RAW aesthetic. No filters, slight digital noise (grain), natural color grading, high dynamic range to capture details without blowing out the highlights.

VARIABLES (Artic Fox example, tweak the prompt to your needs)

{VAR_SUBJECT} = pristine white Arctic Fox

{VAR_FACIAL_FEATURE} = cute wet black nose, massive fluffy ears, and curious whiskers

{VAR_EYES_DESC} = Large, striking golden-brown eyes

{VAR_REFLECTION} = endless snowy horizon and overcast sky

{VAR_TEXTURE_DETAILS} = incredibly dense, multi-layered white fur with actual snowflakes trapped in the coat

{VAR_BIOME} = FROZEN ARCTIC TUNDRA

{VAR_LOCATION_DESC} = a vast, snow-covered wilderness expanse

{VAR_TERRAIN_DETAILS} = fresh powder snow, jagged dark volcanic rocks protruding, and patches of ice

{VAR_ATMOSPHERE} = Freezing, crisp, and misty

{VAR_LIGHTING} = Blue Hour (Nordic twilight; soft, cold, diffuse light before sunrise)
```

## 3829. Korean Girl Group Style Photo Shoot Prompt

- **id**：7519
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=7519

### 描述

A detailed Chinese prompt for generating a four-panel photo collage in the style of a Korean girl group photoshoot, emphasizing delicate facial features, specific makeup details (pink blush, subtle freckles), and soft, bright lighting. It requires an uploaded reference image for identity consistency.

### 示例图

![Korean Girl Group Style Photo Shoot Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769322345144_qxi7qh_G_aUWD4WMAA1YHU.jpg)

![Korean Girl Group Style Photo Shoot Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769322345170_ebehuq_G_aUWDTbMAA7alq.jpg)

### 提示词

```
I. Composition
1 Layout: Overall 3:4 ratio, four-panel collage, 3:4 small images arranged in 2x2
2 Framing: Close-up to extreme close-up, subject occupies a large proportion of the screen
3 Angle: Eye-level close-up, slight left/right variation, uniform clean background

II. Main Subject
1 Reference Source: Use uploaded reference image as the strict identity source
2 Consistency Requirement: Zero deviation
3 Face: Delicate face shape, slightly large eyes, a small mole below the right eye, long and thin nose bridge
4 Skin Quality: Fair with light pink undertones, delicate skin, slight soft focus
5 Details: Prominent highlights on the nose bridge and mid-face, slight redness on cheeks and nose tip, scattered light freckles

III. Makeup Details
1 Base Makeup: Transparent and clean, light matte finish with slight sheen
2 Blush: Pink concentrated on the cheeks and sides of the nose bridge
3 Eye Makeup: Naturally enlarged, long lashes, clear eyes
4 Lip Makeup: Hydrated, plump lips, gradient from light pink to peach, soft cupid's bow

IV. Hairstyle and Accessories
1 Hairstyle: Black long straight hair, center part, full volume, naturally draped
2 Flyaways: Small amount of hair naturally floating around the forehead
3 Hair Accessories: One pink hair clip on each side, bright pink and light pink colors, metal clip visible

V. Hands and Accessories
1 Nails: Extra-long shape, translucent or light colors, with fine glitter and 3D decorations
2 Rings: Multiple pink cute-shaped rings, candy and floral aesthetics, exaggerated but soft and cute volume
3 Hand Gesture Style: Near the face and lips, highlighting nail and ring details

VI. Clothing and Material
1 Top: Fuzzy textured jacket or sleeves, white fluffy and soft
2 Inner Wear: Light pink camisole or top, off-shoulder or one-shoulder effect
3 Overall Style: Sweet and soft, with a touch of cool edge

VII. Four Panel Actions and Expressions
1 Top Left: Hands cupping face close to the camera, expression is cold and slightly wronged, looking directly at the camera
2 Top Right: Finger near the lips or lightly touching the lip edge, eyes calm and slightly teasing, closer extreme close-up
3 Bottom Left: Chin or arm resting on the edge of a table, eyes looking sideways, expression is dazed and vacant
4 Bottom Right: Hand clenched lightly against the chin, smiling but restrained, looking directly at the camera, more approachable demeanor

VIII. Lighting and Tone
1 Lighting: High-key soft light, very shallow shadows, uniform overall
2 Color Tone: Predominantly cool white background, pink accents highlighted, skin tone leans cool pink
3 Contrast: Low contrast, clean and transparent, not heavy

IX. Texture and Visual Effect
1 Clarity: Features and hair strands are clear, skin details preserved but with slight blurring/softening
2 Depth of Field: Background blur is very weak or almost textureless, subject is more prominent
3 Atmosphere: Sweet Korean girl group magazine photo style, sweet and cute, delicate and dreamy, slight glass-like sheen.
```

```
Use the provided reference image as the sole identity and facial structure reference. Create a 3 by 3 grid of face focused portraits of the same woman, maintaining identical facial features, proportions, expression baseline, and realism across all frames.

Each panel should show a distinct head angle and facial perspective, while preserving lighting consistency, lens realism, and natural skin texture. No change in hairstyle, makeup style, or facial identity.

Grid breakdown

Top row
1.Front facing neutral angle, eyes looking directly into camera
2.Three quarter view facing right, slight head tilt, eyes forward
3.Full right side profile, clean silhouette of nose, lips, and jawline

Middle row
4. Three quarter view facing left, soft head tilt, confident gaze
5. Slight low angle looking down toward the camera, subtle power pose
6. Slight high angle looking upward, relaxed expression

Bottom row
7. Head turned right with eyes looking back toward camera
8. Head turned left with eyes looking back toward camera
9. Near rear three quarter angle showing cheekbone, jawline, and ear contour

Technical and visual requirements

Ultra realistic portrait photography
85mm lens look, shallow depth of field
Sharp facial detail, visible skin texture, natural pores
Soft daylight illumination with gentle shadow falloff
Neutral background with no distractions
Consistent framing so all faces align cleanly within the grid
High resolution, editorial quality, fashion and beauty standard

Strict constraints

Do not alter facial structure
Do not stylize or cartoonize
Do not change expression drastically
No text, no watermark, no distortion
Same person in all nine frames

Role Setting: You are an AI prompt engineer proficient in food photography and visual design. Task: Please analyze the food image I uploaded, identify the dish name, main ingredients, cooking logic, and approximate calories.

[General Prompt Template]
Ultra-clean, modern style recipe infographic. Display the {argument name="dish name" default="[Fill in the analyzed dish name here]"} in a highly attractive finished form, with a slight floating effect, using a perspective or tilted view. Arrange the ingredients, steps, and tips around the main dish in a dynamic, editorial layout, not limited to a top-down view.

Pair each ingredient ({argument name="main ingredients list" default="[Fill in the analyzed list of 5-8 main ingredients here]"}) with an icon or mini illustration, and label the quantity in Chinese. Arrange them in groups, lists, or circular flow lines, connected to the main dish via visual lines.
2. Step Area:
Use numbered panels (1, 2, 3...), arrows, or lines to display the production process ({argument name="key cooking steps" default="[Fill in the inferred 3-4 key cooking steps here]"}), forming a clear logical flow around the main dish.
3. Supplementary Information (Optional):
Label in Chinese: Total calories ([Estimated calories]), preparation time ([Estimated time]), cooking time ([Estimated time]), serving size, spiciness, etc., presented in simple bubbles or badge forms near the main dish.
4. Visual Style:
Editorial infographic combined with lifestyle food photography. Food colors are bright and natural, paired with slight shadows, clean vector icons, and modern sans-serif fonts (Chinese HeiTi style). Step panels can use soft gradients or glass-morphism effects. Accent colors are used to highlight key information.
5. Composition Guide:
The finished dish serves as the visual core, using perspective or a tilted angle;
Ingredients and steps flow dynamically around the main dish;
Clear hierarchy: Main dish > Steps > Ingredients > Optional data;
Maintain sufficient white space for an overall light and readable feel.
6. Lighting and Background:
Soft, natural studio lighting, minimalist texture or gradient background, creating a high-end editorial look.
7. Output Specifications:
1080×1080, ultra-sharp, suitable for social media display, no watermark.

The camera is positioned at waist level, looking up as if the viewer is standing at an open car door, with a medium shot capturing the upper body and part of the legs, focusing on the outfit and pose an the viewer exits the car. Color / Tone / Aesthetic: muted brown, olive-green, charcoal palette; cinematic, slightly desaturated; subtle warm sundayfunday undertone in skin and shop interior; overall dark, cozy, rainy-winter vibe (even if no rain visible). Film grain present, slight halation on highlights, mild vignette, soft contrast roll-off. Background softly blurred but readable; subject sharpest point is face and coat collar. Cooks. 

Composition / Camera: vertical portrait (approx 4:5 feel), subject centered slightly left; window text occupies upper third; doorframe and menu board anchor the right third; medium shot at eye level, ~50mm perspective, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic lens softness toward edges.

## 4307. High-End Street Photography Transformation

- **id**：6712
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=6712

### 描述

A detailed instruction prompt to transform an uploaded reference image into a high-end street photography portrait of a traveler/photographer. It mandates preserving the pose and composition while enhancing wardrobe textures, applying cinematic cool-tone grading with warm rim light, and simulating a shallow depth of field prime lens look.

### 示例图

![High-End Street Photography Transformation](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890649998_sozw27_G_BPm1FWIAAGZbR.jpg)

### 提示词

```
transform the photo a reference image into a high-end street-photography portrait of a traveler/photographer leaning casually on a lamp post in front of a historic tower. Keep the original pose and composition: standing with left leg bent and foot on the lamp base, right leg relaxed, left hand in jacket pocket, right hand holding a camera down by the thigh, shoulders slightly turned to camera, chin up and gaze off-frame. Preserve the camera, and textured jacket but enhance and stylize as follows:

Wardrobe & accessories: keep the dark parka/jacket but enrich fabric texture (subtle waxed canvas look), change inner hoodie to a soft charcoal knit, keep blue jeans but slightly deepened to rich indigo with natural creasing. Emphasize the high-top sneakers boost contrast on black-and-white panels and add faint scuff details for

realism. Add a small messenger bag strap across the chest and a compact leather wrist strap on the camera. Lighting & color: cinematic cool-tone grade (soft blue shadows) with warm golden rim light hitting the left side of the face and shoulder (suggest late-afternoon sun). Slightly boost contrast and midtones to create punch without losing skin detail. Add subtle film grain and gentle vignette to focus on the subject.

Camera & optics: emulate 35mm-50mm prime look, shallow DOF (f/1.8-2.8) so the tower and crowd become painterly bokeh while the subject remains razor-sharp. Slight perspective correction to emphasize the tower peek. behind his shoulder. Enhance catchlight/reflection in the eyes (or sunglasses reflection if present) and sharpen

camera details.

Background & atmosphere: keep the busy pedestrian scene but soften and desaturate it so the subject pops; raise clarity and texture on the stone tower so it reads as a strong architectural anchor. Add a few falling autumn leaves and a faint wet-pavement sheen to suggest recent rain (subtle reflections under shoes).. Final touches: natural skin retouching (preserve stubble and pores), boost micro-contrast on jacket and jeans,

accentuate lens/glass reflections on the camera. Export as photorealistic, vertical 4K editorial crop with high

detail.

Position (short): standing, left foot on lamp base, leaning against lamppost, camera in right hand, left hand in pocket, gaze off-frame.
```

## 4340. Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt

- **id**：6819
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=6819

### 描述

An extremely long and detailed Nano Banana Pro prompt for generating a high-fashion editorial image in a Chinese national style (Guofeng), inspired by actress Zhao Lusi and set in the ancient architecture of Chengdu. The prompt meticulously defines the subject's required facial features (100% strict adherence to reference image), styling (vermilion red dress, gold accessories, autumn ginkgo theme), and cinematic technical parameters (Kodak Portra 400 grain, f/1.4-f/2.0 shallow depth of field, warm amber lighting). It uses the 'framed view' (框景) aesthetic common in Chinese art and references photographers like Paolo Roversi and director Wong Kar-wai.

### 示例图

![Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890720533_b8wge3_G-_UqlAXgAEh-tS.jpg)

![Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890720527_n15mke_G-_Ust-XwAAcyxU.jpg)

![Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890720850_6x7njj_G-_Urq7XwAADV8Y.jpg)

### 提示词

```
As a world-class fashion photographer (Steven Meisel / Paolo Roversi / Harley Weir style), shoot a brand-defining autumn Guofeng (Chinese style) fashion editorial for the "{argument name="Brand Name" default="SHANG CHENG SHI"}" brand, using **[Reference Image 1 to 100% strictly restore the facial features, hairstyle, and temperament of the person]**. The film focuses on cinematic close-ups and textural details, integrating Eastern framed view aesthetics with contemporary avant-garde fashion language.

[Core Character Restoration]
Strictly refer to Reference Image 1:

Facial Features: 100% restoration of facial proportions, eye shape, nose shape, lip shape, and facial contours.
Hairstyle: Reddish-brown large wavy curls (fluffy and soft texture, fitting the warm autumn tone).
Temperament: Gentle, relaxed, and languid Oriental female elegance.

But allow the following artistic adjustments:

Makeup can be more cinematic (retaining natural base makeup, enhancing dramatic eye expression).
Hair dynamics can show natural flow due to the autumn wind.
Emotional expression can increase cinematic narrative tension based on "gentle gaze."

[Deep Analysis of Brand DNA - Reference Image 2]
Interpretation of the "SHANG CHENG SHI" brand prototype:

Cultural Gene: Collision of Eastern classical aesthetics and contemporary fashion refinement.
Aesthetic Core: The passionate romance of vermilion red + the gentle poetry of golden ginkgo + the Eastern narrative of red wall framed views.
Target Audience Lifestyle: Urban women pursuing "relaxed elegance," loving the Guofeng atmosphere and refined dressing, aspiring to a life aesthetic that "reveals a contemporary attitude within a classical context."

Brand Visual Language:

High-saturation vermilion red as an emotional anchor.
Autumn ginkgo as a seasonal symbolic system.
Vintage gold jewelry as a carrier of refinement.
Red wall framed view as Eastern compositional philosophy.

[Narrative and Composition - Cinematic Multi-Lens Language]
First Group: Intense Portrait Close-up (Cinematic Facial Narrative)
Shot A - Eye Close-up:
Extremely close focus on the eyes and upper face. The gaze penetrates the lens, conveying the "gentle yet firm" power of the Oriental woman. Emphasize:

Golden ginkgo light and shadow reflected in the pupils.
Detailed texture of individual eyelashes.
Natural tension of subtle expression muscles around the eyes.
Blurred halo of vintage gold necklace on the neck.

Shot B - Side Profile Close-up:
45-degree side angle, capturing the perfect contour line from the forehead → nose bridge → lips → jawline. Reddish-brown curls fall behind the ear, and some strands are outlined with a golden edge by the autumn backlight. The background is a blurred collision of vermilion red walls and golden ginkgo colors.
Second Group: Body Language and Emotional Posture (Cinematic Narrative Composition)
Shot C - Full View of Chin-Resting Gaze:
[Core replication shot of Reference Image 2]
The person sits on the red wall window sill, resting their chin, curled up sideways, with soft and relaxed body lines. But add cinematic texture:

The draping folds of the vermilion red fitted dress show a delicate velvet-like texture in the light and shadow.
Gold bracelets form exquisite light spots on the wrist.
Falling ginkgo leaves create natural foreground occlusion (increasing depth of field layers).
Within the red wall frame, the golden ginkgo tree is rendered with soft focus, creating the Oriental aesthetic of a "picture within a picture."

Shot D - Hand Detail Close-up:
Tight crop: Slender fingers lightly touch the cheek, vintage gold bracelets stack on the wrist. Focus locked on:

The contrast between the fine texture of the metal chains and the warm texture of the skin.
The warp and weft details of the vermilion red cuff fabric.
The natural luster of the nails.
The background is blurred into abstract color blocks of vermilion red and gold.

Third Group: Environmental Atmosphere and Oriental Framed View (Cinematic Scene Narrative)
Shot E - Red Wall Framed Medium Shot:
Using the red wall window frame as a natural frame, the person is centered within the frame. The composition follows the Eastern "framed view into painting" philosophy, but the lighting treatment has the chiaroscuro contrast of European cinema:

The illuminated side of the red wall shows a rough, grainy texture.
The edge of the window frame forms a sharp dividing line between light and dark.
The person is softly illuminated by diffused light (from the ginkgo reflection).
The ancient ginkgo architecture in the background forms an abstract golden-yellow atmosphere outside the depth of field.

Shot F - Dynamic of Falling Ginkgo Leaves:
Capturing the moment ginkgo leaves fall in the air. Foreground leaves are sharp, the mid-ground half-body portrait is sharply focused, and the background red wall and ginkgo tree are completely blurred. Conveys "autumn flow" and "poetic time."

[Styling and Avant-Garde Aesthetics (Key Breakthrough Points)]
Clothing:

Main Body: Vermilion red fitted long dress (draping velvet or thick cotton/linen texture, fitted but not overtly sexy, conveying the "elegant restraint" of Eastern aesthetics).
Avant-garde Elements: Can add asymmetrical cuts or architectural structural lines to the cuffs and neckline, breaking the established impression of traditional Qipao.

Accessories:

Vintage Gold Jewelry: Multi-layered necklaces + stacked bracelets, the metallic luster shows a "bygone era" texture in the warm autumn light.
Unexpected Element: Can add a light sheer shawl (translucent texture) floating in the autumn wind, increasing dynamic movement and layering in the image.

Props:

Falling ginkgo leaves (can hold one, increasing interaction).
Ancient red wall window sill used as a natural seat.

This photo must feel: Original (natural relaxed feeling, not posed), Expensive (texture of high-quality fabric and gold jewelry), Deeply Tactile (the viewer can "feel" the autumn breeze and velvet texture).

[Technical Aesthetics - Cinematic Photography Parameters]
Ultra-realistic Texture:

Film Grain: Medium grain (simulating Kodak Portra 400 film), adding a sense of "time" and "warmth."
Texture Detail: Highly restore pores, hair strands, fabric warp and weft, metal scratches, and the rough surface of the red wall.
Depth of Field Control: Large aperture (f/1.4-f/2.0) to create creamy bokeh, highlighting the subject while retaining the environmental atmosphere.

Lighting - Cinematic Treatment of Autumn Natural Light:

Main Light Source: Softly diffused autumn afternoon sunlight (color temperature 3500K-4000K warm tone).
Auxiliary Light: Golden diffuse reflection from ginkgo leaves (creating soft fill light on the face).
Outline Light: Backlight outlining hair strands and body edges with a golden halo.
Shadow Treatment: Retain soft shadows (not extreme chiaroscuro contrast), maintaining the "reserved blank space" of Eastern aesthetics.

Color - Refined Editing Palette:

Main Tones: High-saturation vermilion red (#C8102E) + warm golden yellow (#F4C430).
Auxiliary Colors: Ancient architecture gray-white (#E8E8E8) + reddish-brown hair color (#8B4513).
Atmospheric Color: Warm orange-yellow ambient light (simulating the "golden hour" before autumn dusk).
Color Relationship: "Passionate collision" of red and yellow + "calm balance" of gray-white = core of "Guofeng atmosphere."

Photography Style Reference:

Paolo Roversi's soft-focus portrait texture (soft yet rich in detail).
Wong Kar-wai's film color saturation and nostalgic atmosphere.
Chinese traditional Gongbi painting's "framed composition" and "philosophy of blank space."

[Final Output Requirements]

Character Appearance: 100% restoration of facial features, hairstyle, and temperament from Reference Image 1 (hairstyle can be slightly dynamic, makeup can be cinematic, but facial contours must be absolutely precise).
Style Atmosphere: 80% reference to Reference Image 2's "Autumn Guofeng atmosphere" (red walls, ginkgo, vermilion dress, chin-resting pose) + 20% world-class fashion photography's "cinematic texture and avant-garde styling."
Technical Standards:

4K/8K ultra-high definition quality.
Cinematic color grading (warm autumn color temperature).
Medium film grain.
Precise depth of field control (sharp subject, soft focus background).

Brand Exposure: Retain the "{argument name="Brand Name" default="SHANG CHENG SHI"}" brand logo at the top of the image (elegant modern font, not distracting from the main subject).
Final Tone: This is not an ordinary fashion editorial, but a cross-cultural visual work that "can simultaneously exist on the cover of an international fashion magazine and in an Oriental aesthetics art book."
```
