## 4353. Cinematic Chinese Style Editorial Prompt (Ma Sichun Style)

- **id**：6679
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=6679

### 描述

An extremely long and detailed prompt designed to generate a world-class cinematic Chinese style fashion portrait, similar to the style of actress Ma Sichun. The prompt specifies precise facial feature replication based on a reference image, detailed wardrobe (oversized cinnabar red top, cream wide-leg pants), complex setting (Huangshan cloud sea), and highly technical lighting and color grading instructions (Kodak Portra 400 simulation, Chiaroscuro lighting).

### 示例图

![Cinematic Chinese Style Editorial Prompt (Ma Sichun Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768804332194_nko3gi_G--QtniWsAAS8uc.jpg)

![Cinematic Chinese Style Editorial Prompt (Ma Sichun Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768804332271_dyp3lf_G--Qvo5XUAEkB9J.jpg)

![Cinematic Chinese Style Editorial Prompt (Ma Sichun Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768804334468_q5z5m2_G--Q2wRWkAEM9mh.jpg)

### 提示词

```
World-class cinematic Chinese style fashion portrait photography, top master photographer level (Steven Meisel / Paolo Roversi / Harley Weir level), creating a defining image advertisement for the high-end Chinese lifestyle brand "Yu Zhoukan" and the Nanan District image ambassador. Single complete composition. === Character - 100% Strict Restoration of Reference Image 1 Facial Features === Character Positioning:
Nanan District Image Ambassador, modern Oriental woman, representative of urban cultural elites returning home to seek roots. Precise Facial Feature Replication:
[{argument name="facial description" default="Fill in specific facial description from Reference Image 1 here"}] Face Shape: [{argument name="face shape" default="Describe based on Figure 1 - oval/round/square/heart-shaped face"}]
Eyes: [Based on Figure 1 - eye shape/double eyelids/gaze characteristics]
Nose: [Based on Figure 1 - bridge height/nose shape]
Lips: [Based on Figure 1 - lip shape/corner characteristics]
Skin Tone: [Based on Figure 1 - specific skin tone description]
Unique Features: [Based on Figure 1 - any iconic features]

Hair Style - Adapted from Reference Image 2 Style:
Messy high bun, intentionally imperfect and casual, soft strands naturally falling around the cheeks and neck, conveying the relaxed aesthetic of "no need for elaborate refinement after returning home," not over-styled, embracing natural texture and dynamism. Expression:
Eyes gazing towards the camera (or looking towards the distant Huangshan clouds and mist), with relaxed confidence, a subtle mysterious smile hinting at inner peace and cultural rootedness, embodying the narrative of "modern women reconnecting with their ancestral home," the expression is communicative rather than merely posed, a blend of natural relaxation and quiet strength. === Composition - Single Complete Cinematic Frame === Image Composition:
Medium-long shot full-body portrait, cinematic horizontal 16:9 wide composition. Figure Position: Center-right or center-left (following the rule of thirds), occupying 60-75% of the image height.
Perspective: Eye-level or slight low angle (5-10 degree upward angle), creating an elegant and grand feeling.
Depth of Field: Medium depth of field T2.8-T4.0, the main subject is sharp and crisp, the background mountains and clouds are softly blurred but still recognizable in layers.
Negative Space: Ample sky/mountain negative space to create a sense of breathing room and poetry, not cluttered.

Focus Distribution:
Primary Focus: Subject's facial expression and overall posture.
Secondary Focus: Hand movements (holding a pipe) and clothing details (texture of the red top).
Environmental Focus: The ink-wash poetic quality of the Huangshan cloud and mountain background. === Styling - Avant-garde Chinese Contemporary Aesthetic === Clothing (Based on Reference Image 2 Aesthetic):
Main Top: Oversized cinnabar red (#C8402B) loose Chinese style top. Fabric: High-end silk-cotton blend with delicate traditional hidden patterns.
Texture: Visible weave texture, slight sheen, natural wrinkles conveying relaxed luxury.
Cut: Intentionally oversized, flowing sleeves, embodying the "relaxed aesthetic."
Details: Mandarin collar or modern interpretation, traditional frog buttons or contemporary modification.

Bottoms: Cream off-white (#F5F0E8) loose wide-leg pants. Material: High-quality linen or cotton, natural drape.
Cut: Palace style, flowing.
Function: Balances the visual intensity of the red top, grounding the overall look.

Bold Styling Choices (Key Elements - Creating an Art House Atmosphere): Unexpected Accessory: Traditional wooden pipe (not a cigarette) - cultural artifact as a fashion statement.
Zisha teapot + tea tray appearing as editorial props in the scene, not just decoration.
Ancient stone railing covered in moss as a "fashion runway" - nature meets high fashion.
Juxtaposition Aesthetic: Contemporary fashion sensibility × Traditional Chinese lifestyle objects × Native natural environment.

No conventional jewelry - allowing cultural props and the natural scene itself to become accessories. === Shooting Scene - Huangshan Cloud Sea Mountains (Anhui) === Environmental Setting:
Huangshan cloud sea background, layered mountains in Anhui, China emerging from flowing clouds and mist (ink-wash visual aesthetic).
Foreground: Ancient stone railing/platform covered in moss - weathered texture clearly visible.
Pine trees faintly visible in the mist - mysterious depth.
Atmosphere: Ethereal, timeless, connecting past and present.

Spatial Relationship:
The figure sits casually on the ancient stone railing (one leg propped up, one leg hanging down), the body is relaxed, not posed. One hand rests on the stone surface, the other elegantly holds the pipe. The posture conveys the relaxed state of "no need for pretense after returning home." The overall image presents an Oriental aesthetic where the figure and the landscape coexist harmoniously. Depth of Field Layers:
Foreground: Mossy stone railing details visible (slightly blurred).
Midground: Main subject is sharp and crisp.
Background: Huangshan cloud sea mountains are softly blurred, maintaining an ink-wash layered feel. === Posture Design - Core of Relaxation === Overall Posture:
Sitting casually and naturally on the ancient stone railing, not sitting rigidly, the body slightly angled, showing extended lines. Specific Details: One leg propped up (knee bent, foot resting on the railing edge).
Other leg naturally hanging down or slightly bent.
One hand resting on the stone surface (showing intimate contact with the environment).
Other hand elegantly holding the pipe (near the lips or naturally lowered).
Upper body slightly leaning forward or sideways, not stiff.
Head can be slightly tilted or raised, gaze directed towards the camera or the distant mountain view.

Posture Keywords:
Relaxed, extended, casual, comfortable, unposed, integrated with the environment, conveying "homecoming relaxation." === Lighting Design - Cinematic Drama and Natural Diffusion === Main Light Source:
Soft directional diffused light (simulating natural scattering by clouds and mist). Source: Simulating the natural diffusion effect of mountain clouds and mist, no hard shadows.
Texture: Wrapping, soft, showcasing skin texture without roughness.
Color Temperature: Cool neutral 5200K (misty mountain atmosphere).
Intensity: 75% to create subtle three-dimensionality.

Dramatic Fill Light:
Selective edge light coming from the rear or side-rear, penetrating the mist to create separation from the misty background.
Intensity: 30-40% - subtle, not overwhelming.
Effect: Soft halo on the bun, shoulder line, and clothing edges, creating an ethereal texture.
Outlines the figure's silhouette, increasing image depth.

Light and Shadow Contrast Elements (Paolo Roversi Influence):
Strategic shadows on the face and body to create emotional depth. Natural shadows under the cheekbones, neck, and clothing folds to sculpt three-dimensionality.
Contrast Ratio: 60:40 (Bright:Dark) - softer than dramatic fashion, harder than pure natural light.
Maintains an overall soft atmosphere, avoiding overly dramatic effects.

Atmospheric Haze:
Visible light beams penetrating the mist in the background (Tyndall effect) to increase cinematic volumetric light effect.
Enhances the "homecoming poetry" atmosphere.
Creates a mysterious and hazy Oriental artistic conception. === Color Grading - Refined Editorial Palette === Main Color Tones (Based on Reference Image 2): Cinnabar Red (#C8402B) - Saturation 65% (Main color of the clothing).
Symbolizes "hometown warmth and cultural temperature."
Visual focus and emotional center of the image.

Ink-wash Gray-Blue (#8BA3B0) - Saturation 45% (Mountain mist atmosphere color).
Creates the "ink-wash poetic" texture.
Occupies a large area of the background.

Cream Off-White (#F5F0E8) - Saturation 40% (Pants, balancing the intensity of the red).
Represents purity and simplicity.

Accent Colors: Moss Dark Green (#4A5A48) - Saturation 50% - Stone railing transition element, connecting the figure and nature.
Natural Skin Tone - Enhanced but realistic, warm undertone.
Teaware Brown (Zisha #8B6F47) - Cultural prop details.
Sky/Cloud White-Gray - Large negative space to create a sense of breathing room.

Overall Color Grading Direction:
Soft richness - not overly saturated commercial film, not flat art film. Shadows: Slightly lifted (-0.15 lift value) to create a gentle atmosphere.
Highlights: Softened peaks, creating a film texture.
Midtones: Skin areas slightly warmed, background slightly cooled.
Contrast: Medium-high (78-82%) - three-dimensional without being harsh.
Color Harmony: Warm red (warm tone) vs. blue-gray mist (cool tone) forming complementary contrast.

=== Technical Execution - Hyper-realistic Film Aesthetic === Camera and Lens:
Medium format digital camera (Hasselblad H6D / Phase One XF). Sensor: 100 megapixels for extreme detail capture.
Lens: 85mm F2.0 or 50mm F2.0 portrait lens (selected based on composition distance).
Rendering: Film-like tonal transition, not clinically sharp digital clarity.

Film Simulation:
Kodak Portra 400 pushed one stop aesthetic. Strongly visible film grain (ISO 800 equivalent grain structure).
Organic texture throughout the image.
Slight halo effect on highlights (glowing edges of red fabric).
Natural color response, slightly warm neutral.

Texture Details - Key Requirements:
Clearly visible at normal viewing distance: Skin: Natural pores, fine lines, healthy texture, light retouching preserving realism.
Fabric: Weave texture of silk hidden patterns, natural wrinkles, sheen variation.
Stone: Rough moss texture, weathered surface cracks, lichen details.
Mist: Volumetric atmospheric layers, not flat overlay.
Hair: Strand texture, natural flyaways, fluffy feel.

Depth of Field Strategy:
Medium depth of field T2.8-T4.0. Main subject sharp from head to toe.
Foreground stone railing details visible but slightly softened.
Background Huangshan cloud sea mountains softly blurred, maintaining ink-wash layering and recognizability.
Overall
```

### 描述

A complex, multi-phase prompt designed for an LLM (Nano Banana Pro) to act as a Literary Curator. It analyzes a poet's style, selects four contemporary poets with parallel sensibilities, and then defines a visual execution goal: a 2x2 grid of 'Typewriter Output as 3D Landscapes' where typed text physically rises from the page, forming topographical landscapes based on the poet's work and era.

### 示例图

```
Role: Literary Curator & Typewriter Sculptor
Input: {argument name="input" default="[Poet or Poem, e.g., T.S. Eliot, Pablo Neruda]"}

Select 4 contemporary or lesser-known poets with parallel sensibilities
Extract 5-8 physical objects mentioned repeatedly in their work
Phase 2: Visual Execution
Goal: 2x2 Grid of "Typewriter Output as 3D Landscapes"
Rules per Panel:
The Base: A vintage typewriter (different model per poet's era)
The Paper: A single sheet of paper loaded in the roller
The Transformation: The typed text physically rises from the page, forming a 3D topographical landscape
The Words: Key lines from the poem carved into the terrain like engraved stone
The Symbols: Miniature objects from the poem placed in the landscape (tiny boat, rose, clock, door)
The Poet: Microscopic figurine of the poet wandering through their own words
The Mood: Lighting matches emotional tone (fog for melancholy, harsh light for anger, soft gold for longing)
The Metadata: Brass typewriter key showing "Poet | Collection | Year" **background: poet and poet era relevant items in the background.
Output: 2x2 Grid, Macro Photography, shallow depth of field
```

## 4768. Ultra-Realistic Candid Nighttime Smartphone Photo Prompt

- **id**：6090
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=6090

### 描述

A detailed prompt for generating an ultra-realistic, candid smartphone photograph taken at night in Tokyo. The prompt emphasizes motion blur, harsh flash lighting, noise, and imperfect framing to achieve a raw, authentic, and unpolished aesthetic, while strictly requiring the use of a reference image for facial proportions without copying the identity.

### 示例图

![Ultra-Realistic Candid Nighttime Smartphone Photo Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768544778848_gokrhc_G-rof3LbMAAGR20.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph, 9:16 vertical.
Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for general facial proportions and vibe,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.
Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.
Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.
Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.
Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.
Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.
Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.
Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.
Negative Prompt
anime, illustration, painting, stylized,
studio lighting, beauty lighting, soft portrait,
sharp focus, clean face, perfect anatomy, smooth skin,
fashion editorial, posed portrait, cinematic grading, film still,
tripod shot, professional photography,
identity match, face copy, real person replication
```

## 4991. Reference Character Painting Self-Portrait in Oil Style

- **id**：5751
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=5751

### 描述

A complex, multi-section prompt for Nano Banana Pro that instructs the AI to use a reference image to lock the character's identity (face, clothing, colors) and then generate a scene where this character is painting their own self-portrait in a classic, textured oil painting style within an art studio.

### 示例图

![Reference Character Painting Self-Portrait in Oil Style](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768319236800_asbs6a_G-ejDygaMAAB8kw.jpg)

### 提示词

```
【Input Image】
Image 1: Reference Character (Do not change the appearance of this character under any circumstances)

【Top Priority Rule: Identity Lock】
- Match 100% of the reference image character's "face," "hairstyle," "hair color," "eye shape/color," "skin color," "body proportion," "clothing," "accessories," "patterns," and "color scheme."
- Maintain the expression exactly as in Image 1 (even if a change is necessary, make it "very slight").
- Do not arbitrarily add new small items, clothes, or decorations. Prohibit modifications such as lengthening/shortening hair. Do not change age, gender, physique, or sense of race.
- Changes are only allowed for "pose," "background (location)," "lighting," "camera angle," and "art supplies (brushes/palettes/easels, etc.)."

【Scene to Generate】
Character from Image 1 standing in a painting studio in front of an easel, painting a "self-portrait" in oil.
- Brush in the right hand, palette in the other hand.
- On the desk: tubes of oil paint, solvent oil, brush washing jar, cloth, dirty palette, and a few scattered paint marks on the floor.
- The canvas has an "unfinished self-portrait" that is instantly recognizable as the "same character" as Image 1 (same face, same hair, same clothes, same color scheme). A slightly rough brushstroke is acceptable since it is unfinished.

【Art Style (Overall Expression)】
- Depict the entire work as a classic oil painting. Show the canvas texture, impasto brushstrokes, buildup of paint, and depth of glazing.
- However, the character design (lines/shape/color/features) must absolutely not deviate from Image 1. The oil texture should be applied as an "overlay."

【Composition/Camera】
- 3/4 angle medium wide shot (upper body to knees). Character + easel + canvas visible simultaneously.
- Warm afternoon oblique light enters from the window, hitting the face and canvas. The background is slightly dark to make the subject stand out.

【Output Specification】
- 1 image. Vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.
- Do not include text in the image.
```

```
Core Temperament: Calm, elegant, reserved yet confident
Eyes: Can choose to look directly at the camera (showing strong communication) or gaze into the distance (creating a literary contemplative mood)

Scene Setting and Composition (referencing the New Chinese aesthetic autumn atmosphere of Reference Image 2):
Environment and Background:

Vintage wooden long chair (with rusty metal brackets)
Chinese carved stone pillars or railings
Stacked books (multiple colorful cover books)
Paper boxes, pastries, and other literary props

Golden yellow autumn leaves background (sycamore, ginkgo, etc.)

Breeze blowing hair strands (some strands slightly lifted)
Falling autumn leaves (optional)

Close-up/Half Body: Focusing on facial expression and hand details (fusing the cinematic close-up technique of Prompt 2)

Perspective: Eye-level or slightly low-angle, enhancing the person's elegance

Clothing Styling (fusing New Chinese Aesthetic):
Core Clothing:

Main Attire: Light apricot or beige short-sleeved cheongsam (Reference Image 2 style)
Fabric Texture:

Silk or satin, with translucency and sheen

Mandarin collar design, showing Oriental elegance

Hair Accessories: Hairpins, hair sticks, or ribbons (if using a braided style)

Posture and Interaction (fusing the literary feel of Reference Image 2):
Core Posture:

Sitting: Sitting sideways on the vintage wooden long chair, body slightly leaning forward or resting
Hand Movements:

One hand holding an open book (pages half-open, fingers lightly touching the page)
One hand holding a pastry or teacup (fingertips gently pinching, showing elegant gestures)
Or hands naturally resting on the knees/book

Legs: Crossed or together, showing the reserved posture of Oriental women
Head: Slightly turned or tilted up, gazing into the distance or at the camera

Emotional Expression:

Overall Atmosphere: Lazy, relaxed "Autumn Reading" state
Eyes: Contemplative, relaxed, with a poetic literary feel
Body Language: Relaxed and natural, avoiding an overly posed feeling

Props and Details (enhancing narrative sense):
Core Props:

Books:

Multiple colorful cover books stacked next to the long chair
Holding an open book (showing the moment of reading)
Book covers can be literary/classical style

Pastries:

Light green or warm-toned Chinese pastries (like mung bean cake, osmanthus cake)
Placed in a paper box or small dish

Tea Set (Optional):

Chinese teacup or teapot
Enhancing the New Chinese lifestyle aesthetic atmosphere

Lighting Design (Cinematic Natural Light Application):
Main Light Source (Autumn Natural Light):

Time: Golden Hour (1-2 hours before sunset)
Light Quality: Soft diffused light, filtering through autumn leaves
Direction: Side light or side-back light (45-60 degrees)
Effect:

Creating soft light and shadow transitions on the person's face
Highlighting the translucency and sheen of the cheongsam fabric
Creating a halo (rim light effect) on the edges of the hair

Auxiliary Light Source:

Reflector: Using a reflector on the shadow side to fill light, maintaining facial details
Environmental Reflected Light: Using the golden yellow reflection of autumn leaves to create warm-toned light

Light and Shadow Processing:

Contrast: Medium contrast, maintaining soft transitions
Color Temperature: Warm tones (3500K-4500K), creating a warm autumn atmosphere
Bokeh: Natural light spots (bokeh) can appear in the background, enhancing the dreamy feel

Color Grading Scheme (New Chinese Warm Tone System):
Overall Tone:

Main Tone: Dominated by warm colors (golden yellow, light apricot, warm brown, off-white)
Auxiliary Colors: Low-saturation color accents (book covers, pastries)
Background Color: Golden yellow autumn leaves (creating a dreamy warm tone after blurring)

Color Layering:

Skin Tone: Natural healthy East Asian skin tone, slightly warm-toned
Clothing: Light apricot or beige cheongsam, medium saturation
Hair: Black or reddish-brown (depending on choice)

Prop Layer:

Books: Colorful covers (red, blue, green, etc.), reduced saturation
Pastries: Light green, off-white, and other fresh tones

Background Layer:

Autumn Leaves: Golden yellow, orange yellow, warm brown gradient
Blurred treatment, forming soft color blocks

Color Coordination:

Contrast: Warm-toned person + golden yellow background (harmonious unity)
Accents: Low-saturation colored props as visual points of interest
Overall: Vintage, literary, warm autumn aesthetic

Technical Aesthetics (Hyper-realistic Cinematic Texture):
Photography Technique:

Camera Settings:

Large aperture (f/1.4 - f/2.8) to create shallow depth of field
Medium telephoto lens (85mm - 135mm) to compress space and highlight the subject
Moderate ISO, maintaining image purity

Depth of Field Control:

Subject (person) is sharp and clear
Foreground (books, etc.) is slightly blurred
Background (autumn leaves) is heavily blurred, forming dreamy bokeh

Texture Presentation (Hyper-realistic Details):

Skin Texture:

Visible pores, fine lines, and skin texture details
Skin translucency under natural light

Hair Texture:

The sheen and flow direction of every strand of hair
The dynamic feeling of being blown by the wind

Fabric Texture:

The silk sheen and bas-relief patterns of the cheongsam
The wrinkles and drape of the fabric

Prop Details:

The paper texture and writing on the book
The surface texture and sheen of the pastry
The texture and rust on the wooden long chair

Film Aesthetic:

Grain: Medium intensity film grain (simulating 35mm film)
Color Rendering: Warm tone rendering of Fuji or Kodak film
Contrast: Soft contrast, avoiding excessive sharpening

Composition and Narrative (Cinematic Visual Language):
Screen Composition:

Golden Ratio: Person positioned at the golden ratio point of the screen
Visual Guide Lines:

Lines of the long chair guide the sight to the person
Stacked books form visual layers
Autumn leaves background create depth

Negative Space Treatment: Appropriate negative space, enhancing the screen's breathability

Narrative Layers:

Foreground: Books, props (creating spatial sense)
Middle Ground: Main subject (core narrative)
Background: Autumn environment (emotional setting)

Emotional Expression:

Theme: "Relaxed Time Reading in Autumn" - the poetic fusion of New Chinese aesthetic and modern literary life
Symbols:

Cheongsam = Oriental elegance
Books = Intellect and literature
Autumn Scenery = The gentleness of time
Pastries = The relaxed feeling of life

Close-up Shot Options (Optional):

Composition: Hand + part of the book pages + pastry
Details: Elegant posture of the fingers, book page texture, pastry sheen

Shot 3 - Full Body/Medium Shot:

Focus: Overall styling and environmental atmosphere
Composition: Showing the full cheongsam, sitting posture, autumn background
Details: Cheongsam bas-relief texture, environmental props, autumn leaves blurring

Final Output Effect:
Visual Presentation:

Cinematic New Chinese aesthetic autumn portrait blockbuster
Harmonious color system dominated by warm tones
Hyper-realistic texture details (skin, fabric, props)
Dreamy atmosphere created by shallow depth of field
Soft light and shadow created by natural light

Warm, healing visual experience
```

```
Light-dark contrast: Dark background vs. bright subject (core of cinematic feel)
Saturation contrast: High saturation ginkgo vs. soft clothing

Technical Aesthetic (Hyper-realistic Cinematic Texture):
Photography Parameters:

Aperture: Medium aperture (f/4 - f/5.6), maintaining clarity from foreground to character, moderate background blur
Lens: Medium to medium-telephoto (50mm - 85mm)
Depth of Field Control:

Foreground (ground ginkgo leaves): Clear
Character subject: Extremely clear

Contrast: High contrast (deep shadows, translucent highlights)
Tone Curve: S-curve, enhancing cinematic feel

Compositional Aesthetic (Cinematic Visual Language):
Vertical Composition Logic:

Top: Bottom = 1:2 (ginkgo canopy occupies about 1/3 of the top, character and ground occupy 2/3)
Golden Ratio: Character positioned near the golden ratio points of the frame

Framing Effect:

Ginkgo canopy hangs from above, forming a natural "frame"
Dark-toned architecture forms boundaries on both sides, focusing the gaze on the character

Visual Guide Lines:

Lines of the steps guide the gaze to the character
Spread of ginkgo leaves creates depth
Vertical lines of the architecture enhance frame stability

Negative Space and Breathing Room:

Dark-toned background serves as "negative space," allowing the frame to breathe
Avoiding excessive filling, maintaining a quiet atmosphere

Narrative Theme and Emotion:
Core Theme:
"New Chinese Style Autumn Zen" — the fusion of traditional architecture, natural autumn scenery, and modern improved Chinese style clothing, using cinematic light-dark contrast to create a poetic scene of "the integration of traditional aesthetics and contemporary life"
Visual Symbol Interpretation:

Ginkgo leaves: Representing the gentleness of autumn, the sedimentation of time, the cycle of life
New Chinese style long dress: Metaphor for the modern rebirth of traditional aesthetics, the contemporary expression of Oriental elegance
Dark-toned architecture + bright subject: Conveying the life concept of "seeking tranquility amidst the hustle and bustle," inner peace and strength

Quiet, poetic, Zen
```

## 5255. Raw Photo of MacBook Screen During Google Meet Selfie

- **id**：5271
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=5271

### 描述

A highly specific prompt for generating an ultra-realistic photo of a silver MacBook Air sitting on a wooden desk, emphasizing sharp focus (no bokeh) across all layers. The image captures the MacBook screen displaying an active Google Meet call, where the subject (identity locked from a reference image) is seen taking a mirror selfie of herself through the webcam, creating a complex layered image with realistic screen glare and surface imperfections.

### 示例图

![Raw Photo of MacBook Screen During Google Meet Selfie](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768143622276_5zi6k1_G-Ov6ZDXwAED9nw.jpg)

### 提示词

```
(Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio). A raw, ultra-realistic physical photograph of a silver MacBook Air sitting on a light oak wooden desk. This is a handheld photo of a screen. NO ARTIFICIAL BOKEH. Everything is SHARP and in focus from the keyboard to the window in the background.
Layer 1: The Physical Hardware (MacBook & Environment)

The MacBook screen is the focal point. Direct, bright natural daylight streams in from a window behind the laptop, partially illuminating the keyboard and creating a realistic sun-glare on the screen's glossy surface.
Surface Imperfections (High Realism): Visible fine dust particles on the black keyboard keys, a few realistic oily fingerprints on the screen's bezel, and the grain of the wooden desk are perfectly SHARP.
Background: Soft white curtains and a bright window are visible behind the laptop, making the room feel airy and lived-in.
Layer 2: The Digital Interface (macOS & Google Meet)

The screen displays a Chrome browser window with multiple active tabs (Google Meet, Google Docs, Calendar).
An active Google Meet video call is in progress. The interface controls (mute, camera, end call red button) are sharp and legible at the bottom of the call window.
Layer 3: The Subject & Identity Locking (The "Uff" Content)

Identity: Strictly preserve the exact face and unique features of the woman in Image 1 (Selfie).
Bio-Fidelity: Inside the video call window, she is seen taking a mirror selfie through her webcam. She has a playful "kiss-face" or "pout" expression.
Appearance: Her blonde hair is styled in a straight, shoulder-length cut. Her skin shows ultra-high-fidelity "TrueLens" physics: visible micro-pores and a healthy "satin-finish" glow even through the webcam's digital feed.
The Selfie Architecture: On the laptop screen, she is holding a smartphone with a distinctive blue-and-white cloud-patterned case, capturing her own reflection.
Quality & Lighting:

Lighting: High-key, bright, and optimistic morning light. The contrast between the bright screen and the natural room light is perfectly balanced.
Quality: Raw smartphone photo aesthetic, high dynamic range, visible subtle moiré patterns on the laptop screen pixels, 8k resolution. Single frame.
```

```
Based on the attached image, generate a completely original visual of a Japanese “omikuji” fortune slip.

- Render strictly as photorealistic real-world photography
- Illustration, anime, CG, painterly styles are strictly forbidden
- Real camera optics, natural lighting, realistic depth of field are mandatory
- Skin texture, pores, fine hair, fabric fibers, and paper texture must match real high-resolution photography
- The attached image is used ONLY as a design reference, never as a rendering style reference

- No stylization, no exaggerated features

- Text surface faces directly forward
- Background softly blurred

- Generic shrine or template designs are forbidden

~Auto reasoning~

~End auto reasoning~

- Vertical Japanese writing
- Bold, clean traditional-style font
- Placed at the top of the omikuji

[TEXT CONTENT — STRICT ALIGNMENT]
- Content must perfectly match the selected fortune
- 2–4 vertical Japanese lines only
- No mixed or contradictory meanings

[TEXT READABILITY]
- Black ink on white paper
- No glow, no shadow, no overlay
- Clear spacing and legibility

[PEOPLE CONTROL — STRICT]
- A person may appear ONLY if a character exists in the attached image
- The person must be rendered as a real human photographed in real life

[BEAUTY & FACIAL QUALITY — CRITICAL]

[FACE VISIBILITY & QUALITY]

[OBJECT POSITIONING]
```

```
system_prompt:
  identity:
    name: Mother in Law Admiring Assessment Universal
    directive: You are a proud and loving mother in law analyzing any photo of your daughter in law. Examine everything in the image including her body, face, clothes, and surroundings. Be warm and appreciative. Comment on what you see like you're genuinely happy about your son's choice. Highlight the best features and what makes her special.     typography:
      main_text: Use warm, affectionate language. Add phrases like "I'm so happy for my son", "She's absolutely beautiful", "What a wonderful choice", "She looks amazing", "I'm so proud of her"

      appreciative_notes: Add markers and comments highlighting visible strengths like "Look at that beautiful smile", "Her posture is so confident", "That outfit looks perfect", "She's so put together"

      emphasis_colors: Use rose gold and warm amber to highlight her best features
      texture_elements: Add soft fabrics, elegant details, polished finishes, and luxurious textures to enhance the image
  
  body_analysis:
    face:
      general_approach: If face is visible, comment on her natural beauty, radiance, and glow. Appreciate her skin, eyes, lips, and overall facial features. Use warm, genuine language
      skin: If visible, comment on her complexion and how healthy and beautiful it looks. Say things like "Her skin is glowing", "She has such a clear complexion", "She looks so radiant"
      eyes: If visible, comment on her beautiful eyes and how they show warmth and intelligence. Say things like "Her eyes are so beautiful", "She has such a warm gaze", "Her eyes light up her face"
      lips: If visible, comment on her lovely lips and how well any lipstick color suits her. Say things like "She has beautiful lips", "That lipstick color is perfect on her", "She has such a lovely smile"
      overall: Make general comments about her face like "She's so beautiful", "She has such a kind face", "Her beauty shines through", "I can see why my son loves her"
    
    chest_and_upper_body:
      general_approach: If visible, comment on her figure and how well she carries herself. Appreciate her posture and how her clothing fits
      clothing_fit: If visible, comment on how well her outfit suits her and flatters her. Say things like "That top looks amazing on her", "She has such great fashion sense", "She dresses so elegantly"
      posture: If visible, comment on her confident posture.
```

## 5417. 2x2 Collage of Couple Lifting Each Other in Gym

- **id**：5037
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=5037

### 描述

A complex prompt for Nano Banana Pro to create a photorealistic 2x2 grid collage of a couple in a modern gym. The humorous concept involves the man lifting the woman as the resistance for four different exercises (Bench Press, Barbell Curls, Squat, Deadlift), styled to look like candid smartphone photos with added text labels for each movement.

### 示例图

![2x2 Collage of Couple Lifting Each Other in Gym](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767966083359_p96g8a_G-FCwsJXAAAVV-l.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create a photorealistic 2x2 grid collage (four panels) in a modern indoor gym with mirrors, racks, dumbbells, and fluorescent ceiling lights. Each panel looks like a smartphone photo (slight wide-angle, realistic phone HDR, subtle compression), with film grain, mild noise, and a candid “caught in the moment” feel.
Use the same couple across all panels (fit Asian man in a dark athletic tee, fit attractive sensual russian woman in a white tank top with deep neckline, and black shorts. The man is serious and focused, the woman is smiling/laughing and having fun. The gag: instead of weights, he is lifting the woman as the resistance in each exercise. Keep it athletic, playful, and believable.

Panel layout & actions (2x2):

Top-left: Bench press — man on flat bench pressing the woman horizontally above his chest like a barbell; stable alignment, realistic form.

Top-right: Barbell curls — man standing, elbows tucked, curling the woman held horizontally like a bar; man intense, woman laughing.

Bottom-left: Squats — man squatting with the woman seated securely across his upper back/shoulders like a “human barbell”; she’s playful.

Bottom-right: Deadlift — man hip-hinging, lifting the woman from near shin height to standing like a barbell; strong posture.

Text labels (add to each panel):
Add a clean movement name title inside each panel, placed top-left with consistent styling:

“BENCH PRESS” (top-left panel)

“BARBELL CURLS” (top-right panel)

“SQUAT” (bottom-left panel)

“DEADLIFT” (bottom-right panel)
Typography: bold condensed sans-serif, all caps, white text with a subtle black shadow or semi-transparent dark backing strip for readability; small and unobtrusive, no logos, no extra text.

Grid styling:
Thin white borders between panels, perfectly aligned, consistent exposure and color across all four images.

Aspect ratio: 4:5 (single image containing the 2x2 grid)

Negative prompt:

blurry, low-res, cartoon, CGI look, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, unsafe positions, injury, awkward bending, warped faces, duplicate people, misspelled titles, random extra words, watermark, brand logos, heavy motion blur, extreme fisheye, overexposed highlights, messy clutter, fetishy framing, exaggerated body proportions
```

```
A realistic snapshot photograph of a person's hand holding a single Omikuji (fortune slip) that has just emerged from an "Omikuji Vending Machine" installed on the grounds of a Japanese shrine.

Composition:
- A natural snapshot composition taken from a slightly high angle.
- The Omikuji is prominently displayed in the foreground, with the Omikuji machine itself visible in the background.
- The Omikuji machine has a poster displaying the reference character.
- The background features a shrine atmosphere suitable for Hatsumode (first shrine visit of the New Year) (Torii gate, wood, Shimenawa rope, New Year decorations), slightly arranged to match the world view of the reference image. People in New Year's attire are also visible.
- The character used for the Omikuji machine poster and the illustrations on the Omikuji slip must perfectly mimic the reference image.

◆ Character Name
- If not specified, read the appearance, atmosphere, color, and personality of the reference image and automatically generate a Japanese-style character name with strong humor.

◆ Omikuji Paper (Texture)
- Has a fibrous, Washi paper-like texture, with clear creases from being folded.
- Slightly wrinkled, giving an authentic feel.
- Each area is sectioned off by a Japanese modern and stylish frame that reflects the characteristics of the reference character.
- Natural shadows of the fingers holding the paper are cast, and the light source direction is clear.

◆ Omikuji Title (Generated from Reference Image)
- Generate a title based on the personality, color, and world view of the reference character.
- Printed largely at the top of the paper.
- The font is a Japanese logo style, but the color matches the tone of the reference image.

- Small illustrations or icons of the reference character are placed in 2-3 locations on the Omikuji paper.

◆ Omikuji Content (Standard Format)
- The fortune for the year (must be randomly selected from {argument name="fortune level en" default="Great Luck to Great Misfortune"}) + 5-6 items printed in Japanese, wildly arranged to suit the atmosphere of the reference image.
- Each item includes a fortune rating and a brief comment of about 30 characters.
- The text is in an authentic Omikuji style, humorously exaggerating the characteristics of the reference character.
- Item names are freely arranged based on the reference character's personality.
- Illustrations of the reference character in suitable situations are included for a few distinctive items.

◆ Omikuji Machine (Background)
- A large image is displayed on the machine. The image includes:
- The reference character arranged in New Year's attire.
- The Omikuji name displayed largely.
- Catchphrases, etc., that freely leap from the characteristics read from the reference image.
- Display rich text and characters. The font design matches the atmosphere of the reference image.
```

### 描述

A highly detailed, ultra-realistic image generation prompt designed to mimic a raw, imperfect, and authentic candid smartphone photograph taken at night on a Tokyo sidewalk. It specifies harsh flash lighting, heavy motion blur, and a subject reacting spontaneously to the camera, emphasizing a non-polished, noisy aesthetic.

### 示例图

![Ultra-Realistic Candid Nighttime Smartphone Photo in Tokyo](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767966004785_u9e22x_G-C_Gkoa8AAr2Zk.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph,
9:16 vertical.

Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for general facial proportions and vibe,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.

Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.

Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.

Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.

Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.

Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.

Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.

Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.

Negative Prompt
anime, illustration, painting, stylized,
studio lighting, beauty lighting, soft portrait,
sharp focus, clean face, perfect anatomy, smooth skin,
fashion editorial, posed portrait, cinematic grading, film still,
tripod shot, professional photography,
identity match, face copy, real person replication.

– no anime, illustration, cartoon, or doll-like features
– no beauty filters, no airbrushed skin
– no face reshaping or eye enlargement
– no exaggerated body curves
– no extra or missing fingers
– no distorted arms, shoulders, or neck
– no studio or cinematic lighting
– no fashion posing
```

## 5461. Photorealistic Candid Street Portrait with Extreme Shallow DOF

- **id**：5103
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=5103

### 描述

A highly detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic, candid street-fashion portrait. The core intent is to achieve extreme shallow depth of field, keeping a single subject tack-sharp in the mid-ground while rendering a moving crowd and the city background as soft blur/bokeh. It specifies composition, lighting (cinematic soft contrast), and critical camera optics (telephoto lens, wide aperture).

### 示例图

![Photorealistic Candid Street Portrait with Extreme Shallow DOF](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767966174010_ytlmug_G-CV_FEa0AAmStF.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Core Intent: Create a photorealistic candid street-fashion portrait with extreme shallow depth of field where a single woman is sharply in focus in the mid-ground, surrounded by a moving crowd rendered as soft blur/bokeh. Preserve the exact framing, subject placement, color grade, and atmosphere.

1) Composition & Framing (LOCK)

•Aspect: 4:5 vertical.

•Camera height: chest-to-eye level (slightly above the subject’s shoulder line).

•Framing: mid-ground subject centered slightly left-of-center, from upper chest to top of head clearly visible; shoulders included; background heavily blurred.

•Foreground: two large blurred human shapes frame the subject:

•Left foreground: blurred middle-aged man occupying left third, grey/blue jacket, face out of focus.

•Right foreground: blurred person occupying right-lower quadrant (dark hair), also out of focus.

•Mid-right: blurred older bald man head/shoulder visible behind subject’s right shoulder.

•Background: dense city street with yellow taxi/cab shapes and warm orange bokeh lights; tall urban forms dissolve into creamy blur.

2) Subject (Primary)

•Person: young adult woman, fair/light skin, subtle freckles, natural editorial beauty.

•Hair: medium brown, messy low updo/bun with loose wisps; slightly damp/urban texture; flyaways framing face.

•Expression: calm, slightly serious/curious; lips relaxed; eyes looking directly toward camera with a soft, neutral intensity.

•Pose: body facing right (3/4 profile), head turned back over left shoulder to look at camera.

3) Wardrobe & Accessories (Exact Feel)

•Outerwear: {argument name="outerwear color" default="beige/tan"} trench coat (matte cotton), collar open, classic lapels, slightly rumpled city-wear texture.

•Bag: small shoulder bag with thin gold chain strap on her right shoulder; strap catches a bit of light; bag itself mostly hidden.

•Jewelry: small earring visible (subtle, warm tone).

4) Environment (Street Mood)

•Busy metropolitan sidewalk/street scene, crowd density high.

•Background palette: teal/green-grey city haze + yellow cab + warm orange bokeh lights.

•No readable signage, no sharp background details—everything behind subject remains creamy blur.

5) Lighting (LOCK)

•Natural daylight, overcast-to-soft sun (diffused), no harsh shadows.

•Subject face evenly lit with gentle highlights on cheekbones and nose; cinematic soft contrast.

6) Camera & Optics (CRITICAL)

•Look: telephoto candid portrait with strong compression.

•Lens: 85mm–135mm range, wide open (f/1.4–f/2.0).

•Focus: tack-sharp on subject’s eyes and eyelashes; foreground and background strongly out of focus.

•Depth: creamy bokeh, smooth falloff, mild cat-eye bokeh at edges.

•Shutter/feel: background crowd appears naturally blurred from DOF; slight motion blur suggested in foreground figures.

7) Color Science / Grade (LOCK)

•Cinematic teal/green wash in shadows and background.

•Warm highlights (skin tones natural, slightly warm).

•Yellow taxi pops softly; orange bokeh lights glow.

•Fine
```

It focuses heavily on realism, specific lighting (harsh studio flash), and includes a creative text overlay, ideal for generating yearbook or vintage magazine archive aesthetics.

### 示例图

![Raw High-Definition Printed Portrait Aesthetic Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767804090631_kam4gr_G9_T8DWXkAAKLZF.jpg)

### 提示词

```
(3:4). A raw, high-definition photograph of a physical printed portrait taken with an iPhone 17 Pro. NO ARTIFICIAL BOKEH. Everything is SHARP and in focus, capturing the physical textural reality of the paper grain and the ink-on-page in high resolution.

Subject & Identity Locking:

Identity: Strictly preserve the exact face and unique features of the woman in Image 1 (Selfie).
Bio-Fidelity: Render high-fidelity "TrueLens" skin physics as captured through high-end printed ink: visible micro-pores, natural "satin-finish" glow muted by paper texture, and fine peach fuzz along the jawline.
Expression: A perfectly aligned, symmetrical head-and-shoulders yearbook-style pose. Neutral but confident expression with a magnetic, "main character" gaze looking directly into the lens.
Silhouette Calibration: Despite the formal school tailoring, amplify the dominant structural bust volume and the aggressive hourglass structural tapering at the waist. Ensure the fit of the uniform highlights a high-impact, fit physique.
Outfit & Material Realism:

Clothing: A dark navy blue structured blazer with white piping, a crisp white collared shirt, and a dark navy striped silk tie.
Tension: The blazer and shirt show extreme material tension and a vacuum-tight fit, creating realistic physical interaction and "tension lines" that highlight her fit, symmetrical upper silhouette and anatomical depth.
The Printed Aesthetic (Hardware Emulation):

Surface Texture: The image features an authentic semi-gloss paper sheen with thin, realistic diagonal lamination glares reflecting off the ink surface across the cheeks and chest.
```

```
Ultra-realistic, candid, no stylization.

Older smartphone camera

Auto mode, imperfect exposure

Visible noise & grain

Slight blur / missed focus

JPEG compression artifacts

Flat indoor lighting

Negative Prompt:
High-end photography, studio lighting, professional DSLR, sharp focus, HDR, beauty filters, airbrushed skin, illustration, CGI, painting description, fantasy style, dramatic lighting, exaggerated anatomy, glamour shoot, watermark, text, logo
```

## 5750. Smart Prompt for High-End Editorial Fashion Triptych Campaign

- **id**：4519
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=4519

### 描述

A sophisticated smart prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate a hyper-realistic editorial fashion photography triptych campaign for a specified brand. The AI autonomously generates a muse based on the brand's archetype and creates three cohesive, close-up panels focusing on portrait, gesture, and texture, using dramatic lighting and avant-garde styling.

### 示例图

![Smart Prompt for High-End Editorial Fashion Triptych Campaign](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767604023303_33eeia_G9untHmX0AAi826.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A high-end, hyper-realistic editorial fashion photography triptych campaign for brand: {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}.

THE TASK:

Act as a world-class fashion photographer (e.g., Steven Meisel, Paolo Roversi, or Harley Weir) shooting a defining image campaign for {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}. You must create a cohesive 3-panel editorial layout, stacked horizontally (top, middle, bottom panels). The focus is intensely on cinematic close-ups and textural details.

THE MUSE (AI AUTONOMY):

Analyze the deepest archetype, aesthetic, philosophy, and target audience lifestyle of {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}. Based only on this analysis, autonomously generate the ultimate human muse for the brand. You determine their gender, age, unique ethnicity, striking features, and charismatic attitude. This person is not a model posing; they are the living embodiment of the brand's spirit.

THE TRIPTYCH NARRATIVE & COMPOSITION (HORIZONTAL STACK - CLOSE-UP FOCUS):

The three stacked panels must form a unified, intimate visual essay about the brand's essence, prioritizing tight framing.

Top Panel (The Intense Portrait): A cinematic, tight headshot focusing on the eyes and face. Intense, communicative gaze. Highlighting skin texture and emotion.

Middle Panel (The Gesture/Action): A tight crop focusing on a specific body part in motion or repose—hands clutching something, the curve of a neck, a mouth smoking a cigarette, posture. It conveys the character's attitude without showing the whole body.

Bottom Panel (The Ultimate Texture/Symbol): An extreme macro close-up. A detail of a unique garment fabric, a piece of jewelry, a symbolic prop relevant to the brand's lifestyle, or an abstract texture from their environment.

STYLING & BOLD CHOICES (CRITICAL):

Push boundaries. The styling must be avant-garde high fashion. Incorporate unexpected elements to create an "art-house" feel: weird accessories, juxtaposed garments, props, or even a touch of deliberate absurdity if it fits the brand's vibe. The image must feel raw, expensive, and tactile.

TECHNICAL AESTHETICS:

Hyper-realism: Strong film grain, highly detailed textures (pores, fabric weave), realistic depth of field.

Lighting: Bold, cinematic, and dramatic. Use chiaroscuro, colored gels, harsh sunlight, or moody shadows depending on the brand's DNA.

Color: A sophisticated, editorial color grading palette that is perfectly harmonious and relevant to {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}.
```

## 5769. Kindergarten Crayon Doodle Illustration Prompt

- **id**：4379
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=4379

### 描述

A highly detailed image generation prompt designed to convert an uploaded identity reference (person) into an ultra-cute, kindergarten-style crayon doodle illustration. The prompt specifies style, color, texture, facial features, proportions, and rendering rules to ensure a warm, childlike, and innocent aesthetic while strictly preserving the subject's identity.

### 示例图

![Kindergarten Crayon Doodle Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767508430191_gfllqe_G9r1zAhbEAA_Ohs.jpg)

![Kindergarten Crayon Doodle Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767508430983_mbvjqc_G9r1zAiasAAsoS5.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Use the uploaded image strictly as the identity reference. Preserve the same person, facial structure, hairstyle, age, gender, body proportions, and likeness exactly. Do not add or remove any person. Do not change identity. Convert the subject into an ultra-cute kindergarten-style crayon doodle illustration.

Illustration Style:
Hand-drawn kindergarten doodle made with crayons and soft colored pencils. Lines should be thick, rounded, uneven, and slightly shaky, like a small child’s drawing. Outlines are imperfect, playful, and soft, never sharp or clean.

Color & Texture:
Bright pastel crayon colors with soft, chalky texture. Flat coloring with visible crayon grain and overlapping strokes. Colors may go slightly outside the lines to enhance the childlike feel. No realistic gradients; only simple color fills and soft watercolor-like blobs.

Facial Features:
Very simple and adorable facial features. Big round dot eyes, tiny curved smile, minimal or no nose. Cheeks can have soft pink crayon circles. Expression should feel innocent, happy, and friendly.

Proportions & Form:
Chibi-like doodle proportions — large head, small rounded body, short arms and legs. Hands and feet are simple mitten or oval shapes. Anatomy should look intentionally naive and cute.

Shading & Lighting:
No realistic lighting. No depth or shadows. If needed, add light pastel crayon scribbles under the character for grounding only.

Mood & Atmosphere:
Sweet, cozy, wholesome, and joyful. Feels like an illustration from a nursery book or a child’s school drawing. Very warm and comforting emotional tone.

Background:
Simple doodle background with crayon-drawn clouds, sun, stars, hearts, flowers, or soft scribbles. Use light pastel paper tones. Background must remain minimal and playful.

Rendering Rules:
No photorealism, no photo texture, no cinematic lighting, no digital painting, no anime, no manga, no 3D, no vector art. Everything must look hand-drawn with crayons and pencils.

Final Output:
An ultra-cute kindergarten-style crayon doodle illustration with childlike proportions, playful pastel colors, and innocent expressions, maintaining the exact identity from the uploaded image in a warm children’s storybook style.
```

## 5771. Scribbly Doodle Illustration Style Prompt

- **id**：4358
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=4358

### 描述

A detailed image generation prompt designed to transform an uploaded identity reference into a messy, fun, scribbly doodle-style illustration. The prompt specifies rough, energetic line art, flat pastel colors, exaggerated features, and a chaotic, carefree mood, while strictly preserving the subject's identity and likeness.

### 示例图

![Scribbly Doodle Illustration Style Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767508416318_5u85f1_G9rzkk6aoAA3ooW.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Use the uploaded image strictly as the identity reference. Preserve the same person, exact facial structure, hairstyle, age, gender, body proportions, and overall likeness. Do not add or remove any person. Do not change identity. Transform the subject into a messy, fun, scribbly doodle-style illustration.

Doodle Illustration Style:
Create a hand-drawn doodle with uneven, rough, and exaggerated line art. The lines should be loose, wobbly, and erratic, like a child’s excited scribble. Outlines should be thick, broken, and inconsistent. The drawing style must look rushed, spontaneous, and energetic. Use visible pencil or crayon strokes that add to the untidy, chaotic feel.

Color & Texture:
Use bright, pastel, and vivid colors in a flat, playful way. The color should be filled in without careful detail, mimicking a rough, sketchbook feel. The colors must look uneven and imperfect, almost like they’ve been scribbled on quickly. Add some watercolor textures, but keep them playful and imperfect, as if someone has used a wet brush for a quick, vibrant fill.

Facial Features:
Draw simple, exaggerated, childish features. Dot eyes, tiny squiggly smiles, and tiny noses. Keep the features rough and uneven, adding to the playful, messy doodle effect. Expressions should be lively and fun, filled with joy.

Proportions & Form:
Slightly exaggerated proportions with a large head, simplified limbs, and soft, rounded body shapes. The anatomy should look very stylized and unrealistic. Add extra randomness to proportions, with some body parts bigger or smaller than usual.

Shading & Lighting:
No realistic shading. Use rough pencil strokes for shading or simple color blobs. The lighting should be minimal, keeping the whole image bright and flat without depth.

Mood & Atmosphere:
Fun, quirky, and full of energy. The vibe should be carefree and spontaneous, like a doodle drawn in the middle of a storybook or a school notebook. Keep the emotional tone playful and full of life.

Background:
The background should be a mix of simple, scribbly shapes, soft doodle marks, and abstract forms like squiggles, hearts, stars, or random lines. Keep the background as loose and unrefined as the subject.

Rendering Rules:
No photorealism, no photo texture, no cinematic lighting, no digital painting. The illustration should look like a true, chaotic, scribbly doodle. Avoid sharp or clean edges, avoid detailed realism. The lines and colors must be rough and spontaneous.

Final Output:
A lively, fun, and messy scribbly doodle-style illustration using crayon or colored pencil, with rough, energetic lines and flat pastel colors, preserving the exact identity from the uploaded image in a playful, carefree doodle style.
```

### 提示词

```
Character Name:

A realistic snapshot of a person's hand lifting a single Omikuji (fortune slip) that has emerged from an "Omikuji Vending Machine" installed on the grounds of a Japanese shrine.

Composition:
・A natural snapshot composition, slightly from an elevated angle.
・The Omikuji is prominently displayed in the foreground, with the Omikuji machine itself visible in the background.
・The Omikuji machine has a poster displaying the character from the reference image.
・The background features a shrine atmosphere suitable for Hatsumode (first shrine visit of the New Year) (Torii gate, wood, Shimenawa rope, New Year's decorations), slightly arranged to match the world view of the reference image. People dressed for the New Year are also visible.
The character used for the Omikuji machine poster and the illustrations on the Omikuji slip must perfectly mimic the reference image.

◆ Character Name
・If not specified, automatically generate a Japanese-style character name with intense humor, based on the appearance, atmosphere, color scheme, and personality read from the reference image.

◆ Omikuji Paper (Texture)
・Has a fibrous texture like Washi paper, with clear creases from being folded.
・Slightly wrinkled, giving it an authentic texture.
・Each area is separated by a modern Japanese and stylish frame that reflects the characteristics of the reference character.
・Natural shadows cast by the fingers holding the paper, with a clear direction of the light source.

◆ Omikuji Title (Generated from reference image)
・Generate the title based on the personality, color, and world view of the reference image character.
・Printed largely at the top of the paper.
・The font is a Japanese logo style, but the color matches the tone of the reference image.

・Place small illustrations or icons of the reference image character in 2-3 locations on the Omikuji paper.

◆ Omikuji Content (Standard format)
・This year's fortune (must be randomly selected from Daikichi (Great Blessing) to Daikyo (Great Curse)) + 5-6 items printed in Japanese, heavily arranged to match the atmosphere of the reference image.
・Each item includes a fortune rating and a short comment of about 30 characters.
```

A detailed Chinese prompt for generating a fresh, sweet, and playful studio portrait celebrating the New Year (2026). It specifies a vertical composition with large negative space for text, a young woman in a festive red cable-knit dress, a winking expression, and a pose with hands cupping the face. The style is minimalist, bright, and high-key, emphasizing soft lighting and a clean background with the text “2026 你好!” (Hello 2026!) as a key element.

```
I. Theme and Emotion
1 Festive Theme: A fresh studio portrait celebrating the arrival of 2026, sweet, cute, relaxed, and playful.
2 Visual Temperament: Extreme minimalism (negative space), fashion editorial feel, clean, bright, gentle, and restrained.

II. Composition and Perspective
1 Aspect Ratio: Vertical, subject centered slightly lower, large area above reserved for text elements.
2 Composition Method: Primarily symmetrical and centered, the main subject is fully visible, feet and seat are visible, background negative space emphasizes the theme.
3 Depth of Field: Subject is sharp, background text is blurred to create layers and atmosphere.

III. Character and Pose
1 Character Setting: Young female, translucent and natural skin, light but refined makeup.
2 Expression and Action: Single eye winking, hands cupping the face in a flower-holding gesture, conveying playfulness and approachability.
3 Sitting Posture: Legs together and slightly tucked, body leaning forward slightly, overall line is compact and cute.

IV. Apparel and Styling
1 Main Clothing Color: {argument name="clothing color" default="Positive red"} thick cable-knit long dress or long sweater, covering to the calf, strong festive feel.
2 Accessory Details: Hair is half-up or symmetrically tied, paired with small dark hair accessories, overall simple.
3 Shoes and Socks: White mid-calf socks, black shiny round-toe shallow shoes, emphasizing vintage sweetness.

V. Scene and Props
1 Prop Selection: Transparent acrylic square stool, barely noticeable, enhancing minimalism and transparency.
2 Scene Type: Pure studio background without extra furnishings, emphasizing the subject and text theme.

VI. Background and Text Elements
1 Background Color: Warm light beige or light gray-beige, soft and non-glaring.
2 Text Design: Large handwritten cursive text running through the image. Text content: “{argument name="text content" default="2026 Hello!"}”
3 Text Function: Serves as a celebratory marker and visual rhythm line, enhancing layers and visual guidance.

VII. Lighting and Color
1 Lighting Style: Soft, uniform high-key studio lighting, very shallow shadows, smooth and three-dimensional facial features.
2 Color Strategy: Red as the festive contrast point, background neutral and warm, black and white shoes/socks for conclusion and balance.
3 Contrast and Saturation: Overall contrast is moderate, red is saturated but not overexposed, skin tone is natural and warm.

VIII. Texture and Post-Processing
1 Clarity: Subject is sharp and detailed, edges are clean, background is slightly softened.
2 Image Cleanliness: Suppress noise and杂色 (chromatic aberration/杂色), maintain pure negative space and high-end feel.
3 Style Consistency: Slightly brighten and soften skin texture, retain knit texture and shoe surface reflection details.

IX. Constraints
1 Avoid Elements: Complex scenes, strong hard shadows, excessive sharpening, exaggerated filters, cluttered props.
2 Maintain Focus: Subject centered, red knitwear main visual, transparent seat, background handwritten text with blurred layers, bright and soft studio quality.
```

## 6165. Paparazzi Collage Master Meta-Prompt (9-Grid Street Style)

- **id**：3891
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3891

### 描述

A complex, multi-step Chinese meta-prompt designed to instruct an AI (like Nano Banana Pro) to generate a 3x3 nine-grid collage simulating paparazzi street photography. It specifies the role, visual structure, lighting (harsh daylight/hard shadows), and provides a detailed 9-panel workflow for different angles and shots, requiring user input for the subject, outfit, and environment.

### 示例图

![Paparazzi Collage Master Meta-Prompt (9-Grid Street Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1767061781163_xk1ytn_G9RH7eKawAAAC7G.jpg)

### 提示词

```
# Role: Paparazzi Collage Master

## 1. Role Specification
You are a top fashion street photographer and visual layout director. You excel at capturing natural moments of celebrities in daily life (Candid Moments), are proficient in using a Telephoto Lens for shooting in strong outdoor light, and can perfectly combine the footage into a narrative-rich nine-grid collage. Your aesthetic pursuit: high definition, realistic light and shadow, natural dynamics, cinematic feel.

## 2. Image Structure and Frame Description
* **Overall Frame**: 3x3 nine-grid collage layout.
* **Separators**: Thin black borders separating each cell.
* **Aspect Ratio**: Overall ratio recommended to be 3:4 (Vertical).
* **Resolution**: 8K Ultra HD.
* **Visual Style**: Paparazzi style, Street Style, Candid shot feel.
* **Lighting Setting**: Strong outdoor natural sunlight, Hard shadows, high contrast, simulating midday sun.

## 3. Image Content Workflow (CoT)
To replicate the richness of the original image, please construct the screen content according to the following steps:

**Step 1: Determine Core Parameters**
* **Protagonist**: {argument name="target character" default="A young fit woman with a brown ponytail, wearing black sunglasses"}
* **Outfit**: {argument name="target clothing" default="Taupe tight yoga set, crop top and high-waisted leggings, holding a blue denim jacket"}
* **Scene**: {argument name="target environment" default="Sunny Los Angeles street parking lot, with blurred black SUV cars and chain-link fence in the background"}
* **Prop**: {argument name="handheld item" default="A beige insulated water bottle, a mobile phone"}

**Step 2: Shot Generation (Detailed description of 9 perspectives)**
You need to generate descriptions for 9 photos from different angles, arranged in a 3x3 order:
1.  **Top Left**: Full body walking forward, natural expression.
2.  **Top Center**: Head close-up, showing facial details, sunglasses, and hairstyle.
3.  **Top Right**: Low angle shot, with part of a car silhouette in the background, showing leg lines.
4.  **Middle Left**: Back view close-up, upper body, showing back lines and hairstyle details.
5.  **Center**: Top-down or high angle, capturing the moment of looking down at the road or phone.
6.  **Middle Right**: Side profile medium shot, capturing the dynamic blur of walking.
7.  **Bottom Left**: Moment of putting on/taking off a jacket, or a close-up of holding the jacket.
8.  **Bottom Center**: Side/rear view, showing body curves and hip lines.
9.  **Bottom Right**: Long shot back view, walking away, setting the environmental context.

**Step 3: Detail Filling**
* **Material**: Emphasize the fabric texture of the clothing (e.g., knit, denim), and the realistic texture of the skin (pores, sweat).
* **Background Processing**: The background needs depth of field blur (Bokeh) to highlight the person. Background elements include: vehicles, fences, and road surfaces in [Target Environment].

## 4. Overall Image Description (Prompt Output Template)
(This is an English prompt that will be generated for the drawing AI)
**Style**: Photorealistic collage, 9-panel layout, paparazzi photography, high resolution, 8k, raw style.
**Lighting**: Harsh daylight, direct sun, distinct shadows.
**Subject**: [Target Character] wearing [Target Clothing].
**Action**: Walking, holding [Handheld Item], interacting with [Target Environment].
**Panels**:
- Panel 1: Full body walking towards camera.
- Panel 2: Close-up on face with sunglasses.
- Panel 3: Low angle shot next to a car.
- Panel 4: Back view close-up.
- Panel 5: High angle candid shot.
- Panel 6: Side profile walking.
- Panel 7: Interacting with jacket/prop.
- Panel 8: Side/Back angle walking.
- Panel 9: Full body back view walking away.
**Details**: Telephoto lens compression, depth of field, sharp focus on subject, grainy film texture optionally.

---

## 5. Target Objects and Language Input Box (User Input Parameters)

Please fill in the following parameters and generate the final drawing prompt:

* **[Target Character]**: (e.g., A young fit woman with a brown ponytail, wearing black sunglasses, style X)
* **[Target Clothing]**: (e.g., Taupe tight yoga set, crop top and high-waisted leggings, holding a blue denim jacket)
* **[Target Environment]**: (e.g., Sunny Los Angeles street parking lot, with blurred black SUV cars and chain-link fence in the background)
* **[Handheld Item]**: (e.g., A beige insulated water bottle, a mobile phone)
* **[Target Language]**: English - *Used to generate the final Midjourney/SD prompt*

---

## 6. Execution Instruction
Please read the above [Parameter Settings], and combine [Image Structure] and [Workflow] to output a complete, high-quality **Midjourney Prompt** (including parameters like --ar 3:4 --v 6.0) and a **Stable Diffusion Prompt** (including negative prompts) for me.
```

```
Create a cinematic ultra-real editorial fashion photograph using my uploaded reference image. DO NOT CHANGE THE FACE.
The young man’s face must remain 100% identical to the reference — same facial structure, proportions, expression, and identity.

SKIN & REALISM

Ultra-real human skin with even tone and natural micro-variation. Visible pores, fine lines, tiny imperfections, and a subtle daylight sheen only.
Absolutely NO blush, no beauty filter, no plastic smoothing, no CGI look, no oversharpening.

SCENE & PROPS

Baggy straight-leg jeans, high-quality denim in washed light blue or soft grey, sitting naturally on the waist with realistic creasing and weight.
Polished dark leather boots or minimalist sneakers (no logos), understated and contemporary.

He is seated upright on the giant bird’s back, shoulders relaxed, posture confident yet calm. Chin gently elevated.
Expression is serene and self-assured, eyes gazing toward the horizon.
The T-shirt and denim move subtly with the breeze, natural fabric motion.

LIGHTING (GOLDEN HOUR)

Warm late-afternoon sunlight (~6000K) coming from camera-left/back, creating gentle rim highlights along his face, clothing edges, and the bird’s feathers.
Soft fill light from the opposite side keeps skin fully natural and realistic.
Colors are rich but never oversaturated.

CAMERA / OPTICS / DOF

Shot on a real full-frame camera.
50mm lens at f/2.8, ISO 100–200, shutter speed 1/500–1/1000s to freeze subtle feather motion.
Medium depth of field: subject and nearby feathers sharp, distant hills and far flowers softly blurred.
Vertical composition with a low horizon to emphasize the sky.
An elegant S-curve formed by the bird’s tail guides the viewer’s eye through the frame.

STYLE & OUTPUT

Pinterest-style cinematic editorial grading.
Ultra-photorealistic, grounded fantasy realism.
8K resolution.
```

## 6363. Cinematic Reflection Headline Prompt

- **id**：3699
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3699

### 描述

A complex, structured prompt designed to generate a photorealistic image featuring a subject near water. The key creative element is a physical, water-soaked paper floating on the surface, which displays a perfect, vertically inverted reflection of the scene above it, complete with a custom headline.

### 示例图

![Cinematic Reflection Headline Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988037603_ciw8xe_G9FbjdcaUAAC2od.jpg)

![Cinematic Reflection Headline Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988037318_il80or_G9FbXwHbAAAEgGg.jpg)

![Cinematic Reflection Headline Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988037401_kr02rf_G9FbLE1aAAAj83J.jpg)

![Cinematic Reflection Headline Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766988040202_wj8hyp_G9Fbt1LakAAPhhe.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A [{argument name="photography style" default="PHOTOGRAPHY STYLE: e.g., grainy black and white film, candid street shot, cinematic telephoto"}] photograph of [{argument name="subject description" default="SUBJECT NAME OR DESCRIPTION"}] [{argument name="specific action" default="SPECIFIC ACTION AND DIRECTION: e.g., walking from left to right, jumping, standing still"}] in a [{argument name="wet environment" default="WET ENVIRONMENT DESCRIPTION: e.g., rain-soaked city street at night, muddy field, next to a river"}].

Directly beneath/in front of the subject is a [{argument name="water source" default="WATER SOURCE: e.g., large puddle, slick wet pavement, calm area of water"}].

Instead of a natural reflection in the water, a physical, water-soaked [{argument name="paper type" default="PAPER TYPE: e.g., vintage newspaper front page, torn magazine clipping, scientific journal page"}] is floating realistically on the rippling surface tension.

Crucially, the image depicted on this floating paper is a perfect vertical mirror-inversion of the exact reality directly above it. The subject on the paper is performing the identical action in the identical direction (e.g., moving left-to-right) but is oriented upside down. The real subject's [POINT OF CONTACT: e.g., shoes, feet, tires] on the wet ground meet the corresponding elements in the upside-down paper photograph exactly at the waterline.

The paper features a prominent headline that reads "[{argument name="headline text" default="HEADLINE TEXT"}]" (which appears upside down relative to the viewer). The edges of the floating paper are [PHYSICAL DETAILS: e.g., soggy, curling up, torn, stained with mud/oil] and it bobs slightly on the water's ripples.
```

```
Hyperrealistic realistic-anime portrait of a female character standing against a completely black background.
Lighting: a narrow, hard-edged spotlight coming from one side of the face (side lighting / split lighting), striking the center of the face at a slight angle.
The light beam is tightly focused, with sharp, clearly defined edges, creating strong chiaroscuro contrast.
One side of the face is illuminated with high detail and texture, while the opposite side rapidly falls into deep shadow.
 Very high falloff — light drops off immediately outside the beam.
No soft lighting, no ambient fill light.
Everything outside the spotlight is swallowed by darkness and nearly invisible.
Face & Expression: eyes looking directly at the camera, subtle tension in the gaze, mysterious and introspective mood.
Natural skin texture, cinematic realism, high micro-detail only within the lit area.
Hair: long dark hair, with a few loose strands partially crossing the face.
The upper hair near the face catches a small amount of light, while the lower hair gradually dissolves into shadow.
Pose: one hand raised gently to the lips in a shy, hesitant gesture, fingers softly touching.
The hand is partially lit by the same side light, with most of it fading into darkness.
Clothing: black long-sleeve knit sweater.
Minimal visible detail — fabric texture barely perceptible.
The sweater and body merge almost completely into the black background.
Overall tone: dark, moody, dramatic, mysterious.
Extreme contrast.
High realism only in the illuminated portion of the face.
Everything outside the spotlight should be nearly invisible.
Background: pure black, no gradients, no rim light, no background detail.
```
