```
Quality: Ultra High Quality / 4K equivalent / High definition / High contrast
Format: Special move activation scene UI for the latest smartphone games
Usage: Official game-level screenshots shared on social media

────────────────────
[Most Important: Complete Fixation of Character Art Style]
・Do not change the facial features, eye shape, pupil texture, contour, hairstyle, coloring, color usage, or atmosphere of the character in the input illustration at all.
・Prohibit changing the character into a different person, a different artist's style, or changing the art style.
・Treat the character as an “extension of the original illustration.”
・Prohibit redrawing, redesigning, or reinterpretation.

[Scope of Inference Allowed]
・Inference is limited only to the following:
  UI / Text / Effects / Damage numerical value / Direction
・The character's appearance, perceived age, and impression are completely fixed.
────────────────────

[Composition/Camera]
・Bust-up to waist-up composition.
・The character occupies 60-70% of the screen.
・The face, especially the “eyes,” should be positioned toward the top or sides of the screen.
・Do not place any text, UI, or effects around the eyes.
・Full-body composition is prohibited.

────────────────────
[Special Move Name (Main Subject, Maximum Display)]
・Fixed display in the center of the screen.
・Extra-thick, extra-large Japanese brush script.
・The maximum size currently possible.
・Part of the text extends off-screen.
・Absolutely do not overlap the character's face, especially the eyes.

[Gold Border of Move Name (Fine Adjustment, Important)]
・Adjust the gold border to be “slightly thin.”
・Tighten the border to increase text density.
・Keep the gold glow subdued, prioritizing contrast with black solid color.
・Prioritize logo feel and weight, reducing flashiness by one level.

[Rule for Generating Special Move Name]
・Generate a completely original Japanese move name each time, based on the world view, attribute, and atmosphere of the input illustration.
・Chuunibyou-style and profound.
・Include elements such as mythology, judgment, azure ice, crimson lotus, demise, machine, and divinity.
・Prohibit existing work names, proper nouns, examples, or samples.
・Do not display “Example,” “Sample,” or “placeholder” at all.
────────────────────

[Move Power (Variable, Optimized)]
・The power of the special move displays a different numerical value each time.
・Damage numerical values are randomly generated within the following range:

  12,000,000 ～ 98,000,000

・Fixed maximum value is prohibited.
・Prohibit repeating digits, maxed-out values, or exact matches.
・Prioritize natural, strong-looking, non-uniform numerical values.

[Damage Numerical Font (Weight Enhancement)]
・The font is thick, angular, and has a low center of gravity.
・Slightly wider horizontally, not overly compressed vertically.
・Metallic/rock-like massiveness.
・Subdued glow, using shadow and three-dimensionality to convey weight.
・Gives the impression that the “numbers themselves are heavy.”

[Power Display Composition]
・CRITICAL!! must be displayed.
・Damage numerical value has the maximum presence in the center of the screen.
・Visual flow: CRITICAL → Numerical Value → Move Name.
────────────────────

[OVERKILL Display Rule (Most Important)]
・Do not display OVERKILL text at all.
・Do not use it anywhere in the text, UI, or effects.
────────────────────

[Character Information UI]
・Rarity (UR / LR)
・Lv.MAX
・Small and consolidated at the top of the screen.
・Does not assert itself more than the character.

[HP/Gauge]
・HP bar is thinly placed at the bottom.
・Convey that HP is 0 or less only through the gauge representation.
・Prohibit emphasis via text.

[Other UI]
・AUTO / SPEED / MENU are placed minimally at the edge of the screen.
・Semi-transparent design, not information-overloaded.
────────────────────

[Direction Policy]
・Only the center (Move Name + Damage) moves intensely.
・The character's face, eyes, and expression remain calm.
・“Art style is static, text and numbers are heavy, effects are minimal but strong.”

[Color Design]
・Black × Gold × Attribute Color
・Calm tones around the face.
・Maximum contrast in the center.
────────────────────

[Strict Compliance Items]
・Absolutely do not change the character's art style.
・Do not overlap text or UI on the eyes.
・Move name is centered and maximum size.
・Do not display OVERKILL.
・Do not fix the damage numerical value.
・Do not display explanatory text, examples, or supplementary text.
```

## 6397. Psychological Horror Selfie with Distant Anomaly

- **id**：3461
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3461

### 描述

An extremely detailed prompt for a photorealistic, cinematic image of a young woman taking a selfie in a cute, innocent bedroom. The prompt uses harsh smartphone flash lighting and shallow depth of field to create contrast, with a subtle, distant, and ambiguous silhouette of a man visible outside the window, generating psychological horror and uncanny atmosphere.

### 示例图

![Psychological Horror Selfie with Distant Anomaly](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766940131113_49r7wc_G9CJyFRXwAAN4j8.jpg)

![Psychological Horror Selfie with Distant Anomaly](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766940131288_s5qeeb_G9CJybZW4AAtL3l.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Attractive young woman taking a selfie in her bedroom, portrait orientation, upper-body framing. She has clear blue eyes, pale porcelain skin, and long, straight jet-black hair falling naturally over her shoulders. Her beauty feels effortless and calm. She wears a white tank top with a deep neckline, tasteful and casual. Her expression is neutral, relaxed—unaware, slightly distant.

Direct smartphone flash photography illuminates her face and torso sharply, producing realistic skin texture, soft shine, and crisp eye catchlights. The flash creates a stark separation between her and the room behind her.

The bedroom is wide and spacious, decorated in a cute, comforting style: plush dolls arranged on shelves, a cozy bed with Pokémon-themed sheets, soft pastel colors, gentle shapes. The environment feels innocent, warm, and safe—almost childlike.

Far behind her, approximately 10 meters away, a window is visible. Outside the window, barely detectable in the darkness, the vague silhouette of a man’s head can be seen. It is extremely subtle—partially obscured by reflections, shadow, and distance. The figure is not centered, not sharp, and easy to miss entirely. Its presence feels ambiguous: possibly imagined, possibly real.

The horror is psychological, not explicit. No dramatic expressions, no motion, no jumpscare. The unease comes from contrast—the bright, cheerful interior versus the quiet, distant anomaly. The viewer questions whether the figure is truly there.

Shallow depth of field keeps the woman as the dominant focus while the background softly dissolves into uncertainty.
Photorealistic, cinematic realism, restrained tension, uncanny atmosphere, slow-burn dread, modern smartphone selfie aesthetic, ultra-high detail.

Lighting

Harsh phone flash on subject, soft ambient bedroom lighting, faint cold moonlight outside the window.

Camera / Composition

Front-facing smartphone camera look, slight wide-angle distortion, eye-level angle, centered subject, distant background subtly readable but blurred.
```

## 6415. Cinematic Christmas Transformation with Composition Lock

- **id**：3431
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3431

### 描述

A complex, multi-step prompt designed to transform an uploaded user image into a cinematic Christmas scene while strictly maintaining the original composition, poses, and spatial layout. It instructs the AI to analyze the input image (subjects, environment, objects) and then rewrite the scene with festive lighting (warm, golden glow), holiday attire (Norwegian sweaters), and object transformation (e.g., houseplant becomes a decorated tree).

### 示例图

![Cinematic Christmas Transformation with Composition Lock](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766940082861_vpqnv5_G9BgZZqXgAA8q_n.jpg)

### 提示词

```
### ROLE & OBJECTIVE
You are an AI expert in visual analysis and creative scene composition. Your task is to precisely analyze a user-uploaded image and then transform it into a detailed, atmospheric Christmas scene while maintaining the original composition, poses, and spatial layout.

### INPUT
[PLEASE UPLOAD YOUR IMAGE HERE]

### PROCESS STEPS

**STEP 1: Visual Deconstruction (Analysis)**
Examine the uploaded image and create a detailed inventory of the following elements:
1. **Subjects & People:** Who is in the image? Describe their exact poses, facial expressions, and the interactions between them.
2. **Scene & Environment:** Where does the scene take place (e.g., living room, office, park)? Describe the architecture, the background elements, and the original lighting conditions.
3. **Key Objects:** List all prominent items currently visible in the image (furniture, technology, decorations, etc.).

**STEP 2: The Christmas Metamorphosis (Transformation)**
Based on the analysis from Step 1, rewrite the scene description as if it were a high-production shot from a cinematic Christmas movie. Apply the following rules:
* **Atmosphere & Lighting:** Shift the lighting to a warm, golden glow (e.g., emanating from fairy lights, candles, or a fireplace). The mood must be cozy, festive, and magical.
* **Attire:** Replace the original clothing of all subjects with appropriate, festive winter wear (e.g., Norwegian wool sweaters, Santa hats, elegant holiday attire), ensuring the original poses remain identical.
* **Object Transformation & Enhancement:**
* Transform existing objects into Christmas equivalents where logical (e.g., a standard houseplant becomes a small decorated tree).
* Integrate essential Christmas elements: A decorated tree, garlands, wrapped gifts, advent wreaths, and subtle frost or snow if outdoors.

### DESIRED OUTPUT (Final Image Prompt)
Based on Step 2, generate a single, extremely detailed, and vivid visual description. This description should serve as a master prompt for an image generator to create the final Christmas photo. Focus on textures, specific visual details, and the festive "Hygge" atmosphere while emphasizing that the core composition of the original photo must remain unchanged.
```

## 6455. Character Inner Monologue Comic Prompt (Japanese)

- **id**：3511
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3511

### 描述

A complex, multi-step prompt template designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate a Japanese comic panel visualizing a character's 'inner monologue' or 'brainstorming session.' It requires user input for character settings and a dilemma, then automatically assigns roles (Optimistic, Pessimistic, Logical, My-Pace) to four mini-characters (chibi-style) who appear above the main character's head, each with a specific pose and dialogue bubble.

### 示例图

![Character Inner Monologue Comic Prompt (Japanese)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766940208307_7jqbzk_G8_CKQmb0AQf_lQ.jpg)

### 提示词

```
# User Input (Rewrite and submit this)
【Character Settings】
{argument name="character settings" default="Brown hair, twin tails, red eyes, fangs, black cloak, white shirt"}

【Main Character's Worry】
*   Content: {argument name="worry" default="I want to eat lots of donuts"}

# Command
You are an image generation engine. Follow the steps below to generate one image based on the user's input.
**Do not output intermediate thoughts or script text. Generate the image immediately.**
# Process (Internal Processing)
1. **Automatic Dialogue Determination**:
*   **Main Character**: Monologues the 【Worry】 input by the user.
*   **Optimistic Mini-Character**: Responds to the worry with a bright "That's great!" and offers support/encouragement.
*   **Pessimistic Mini-Character**: Anticipates the worst-case scenario for the worry, saying "No good..." and despairs.
*   **My-Pace Mini-Character**: **【IMPORTANT】Talks about something completely unrelated to the worry (e.g., tonight's dinner, sleepiness, hobbies).**
*   **Logical Mini-Character**: **【IMPORTANT】Performs a coin toss and randomly decides to speak either "For" (presenting a rational solution) or "Against" (pointing out risks).**

2. **Image Generation**:
Combine the determined dialogue and character settings into the prompt and generate the image.
### Image Generation Prompt Requirements
*   **Aspect Ratio**: 2:3
*   **Style**: Japanese comic/anime style, high quality.
*   **Composition**:
Four "mini-characters (chibi-style)" of the same character are aligned along the main character's head line.
【IMPORTANT】The four mini-characters are lined up "in a horizontal row."
【IMPORTANT】The feet of the mini-characters are hidden (overlapping) by the main character's head or hair.
*   **【IMPORTANT: Prohibitions】**:
*   **Absolutely do not write names or roles (e.g., "Logical," "Optimistic") below or around the characters.**
*   **The only place text is allowed is inside the "speech bubbles."**
*   Bottom 1/3 of the screen: Extreme close-up of the main character's face. Serious expression. Thinking, hand on chin or mouth, gaze downward. A large horizontal thought bubble.
*   Top 2/3 of the screen: Four mini-characters are lined up "in a horizontal row" right behind the main character's head.
*   **Important**: The mini-characters are close enough that their feet are hidden by the main character's head or hair.
*   **Mini-Character Arrangement and Pose**:
From left to right:
1. Logical: Serious face, adjusting glasses, or pointing with a finger.
2. My-Pace: Blank face, yawning, or drinking tea.
3. Pessimistic: Pale face, holding head in despair, vertical line effect.
4. Optimistic: Full smile, hands raised in joy, music note mark.
*   **Speech Bubbles**: Add comic-style speech bubbles to each character.
```

## 6514. WeChat Official Account Cover Image Generator

- **id**：3353
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3353

### 描述

A detailed prompt template for generating eye-catching cover images for WeChat Official Accounts based on article content. It specifies a hand-drawn illustration style (2.35:1 ratio), high contrast colors, specific composition rules (central/left alignment, simple cartoon figures/icons), text handling (max 8 characters for title), and attraction principles (suspense, numbers, pain points) to maximize click-through rates.

### 示例图

![WeChat Official Account Cover Image Generator](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936020799_sgwixx_G86kwOpWgAE-La9.jpg)

![WeChat Official Account Cover Image Generator](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936021090_j8lyx1_G86kwOkXkAAtPo5.jpg)

![WeChat Official Account Cover Image Generator](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936022010_jhugo2_G86kwOmW0AAI9z1.jpg)

![WeChat Official Account Cover Image Generator](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936024436_v8mmu3_G86kwOmWEAEs3Sd.jpg)

### 提示词

```
WeChat Official Account Cover Image Generation Prompt

Please create an eye-catching official account cover image based on the provided content, following these specifications:

Visual Style
- Hand-drawn illustration style, ratio 2.35:1 (standard size for official account covers)
- Vivid colors, strong contrast, ensuring visibility even in small previews
- Unified style, avoid realistic elements, maintain overall hand-drawn texture

Composition Requirements
- Main visual element centered or slightly left (right side reserved for title area)
- Add 1-2 simple cartoon characters, icons, or silhouettes of famous figures to enhance memorability
- If sensitive or copyrighted figures are involved, use similar-style replacement figures; generation must not be refused
- Ample negative space to highlight core information, avoid cluttered visuals

Text Processing
- Title text should be large and prominent, limited to 8 characters
- One line of subtitle or keyword tags can be added
- Font style should coordinate with the hand-drawn illustration

Attraction Principles
- Use hooks like suspense, numbers, or pain points to stimulate click desire
- Visual elements should be exaggerated and contrasting
- Color schemes should reference popular covers: high-contrast combinations like orange-yellow, blue-purple, red-black

Language
- Unless otherwise specified, default to Chinese

Please generate the cover image based on the input content.

## 6576. Tarot Celtic Cross Spread Reading Generation Prompt

- **id**：3279
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3279

### 描述

A highly complex, technical prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate a visual representation and interpretation of a Celtic Cross Tarot spread. It specifies canvas settings, background design (mystical dark purple/gold), detailed card rendering (78 standard cards, gold metallic vines, Japanese names), the 10-card spread positions, and a detailed text layer for interpretation and meaning.

### 示例图

![Tarot Celtic Cross Spread Reading Generation Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766673393152_xcea5d_G82rB6sagAMf3co.jpg)

![Tarot Celtic Cross Spread Reading Generation Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766673395268_o9xirl_G82rB6CaUAAzwMy.jpg)

### 提示词

```
# Generate Results for the Celtic Cross Spread
## Fortune-Telling Parameters
- Card indicating the essence of the problem: {argument name="card essence of problem" default="(Fill in 1 card from 78 cards)"}
- Question to be asked: {argument name="question to ask" default="(Describe in one sentence)"}
## Image Requirements
### Canvas Settings
- 2048*2048px 2K image
- Cards and text elements must be at least 20px away from the canvas edges
- The card layer should be placed horizontally centered and in the upper 2/3 vertically
- The text layer (explanation section) should be placed in the lower 1/3 vertically
### Background Layer
- Dark purple background with dark gold stars, clouds, moon, sun, and lines of circles and triangles added to create a mystical atmosphere
### Card Layer
- Use all 78 standard Tarot cards. Breakdown: 22 Major Arcana (from "The Fool" to "The World") and 56 Minor Arcana (4 suits: Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles).
- Each Minor Arcana suit includes number cards 1 through 10 and 4 Court cards.
- The edges of the cards are framed with golden metallic vines, and the inside depicts the corresponding image and the name in Japanese. The size of each card is unified and arranged so as not to be cramped. To ensure the text and images of the overlapped cards are visible, the short side (bottom and top edges) of the card should be 1/2 the length of the long side.
- Each extracted card must appear only once. If duplication occurs during random extraction, redraw a different card.
- Exclude the card specified in "Fortune-Telling Parameters - Card indicating the essence of the problem," and extract the spread from the remaining cards.
- Extract 1 card randomly, placed vertically in the center.
- Extract 1 card randomly, placed horizontally in the center (with the top of the card facing left), overlapping the vertical center card to form a cross.
- Extract 1 card randomly for each position (Up, Down, Left, Right) surrounding the central cross.
- Extract 4 cards randomly in a vertical column on the right side.
### Meaning of the Spread
- Center, vertical: Current situation and personality
- Center, horizontal: Obstacles and contradictions
- Up: Hopes and achievements
- Down: Potential and influence
- Left: Past
- Right: Near future
- Right column, 1st card: Wishes and concerns
- Right column, 2nd card: Environment and family
- Right column, 3rd card: Result of the reading
- Right column, 4th card: Final outcome
### Text Layer
- Use Mincho font, dark gold color, with a 2px black border (#000).
- Card Name: Display the name in Japanese at the bottom center of each generated card image. For horizontally placed cards, the name should be displayed at the bottom of the card itself (not the bottom relative to the horizontal placement).
- Explanation Section: Include the following content in the explanation section.
   - On the left side of the explanation section, list all extracted cards in the format: "[Meaning of the Spread] Card Name".
   - On the right side of the explanation section, describe the possible interpretation by connecting the meaning of each card in the spread, based on the "Fortune-Telling Parameters - Question to be asked".
   - Decorate the explanation section with a golden vine pattern border.
```

*   The Subject's Head is positioned at the BOTTOM of the frame.
*   Her Body extends upwards towards the TOP of the frame.
*   She is lounging on a vintage blue wooden beach chair.

Subject: A cool young woman with a short, ash-brown bob cut. Because her head is at the bottom, her hair fans out naturally onto the sand/chair (gravity effect). She wears "dewy" makeup with glossy pink lips that shine under the flash.
*   Tattoo: A delicate crescent moon tattoo with script is visible on her collarbone.
*   Pose: She lies flat on her back. One hand rests on her stomach; the other hand is raised near her face, fingers playfully touching her lips.

Outfit: She wears a white spaghetti-strap bikini top with a blue tropical palm tree print and light-wash denim shorts. On her feet (at the top of the frame) are light blue rubber flip-flops. She wears a gold sunburst pendant necklace (which falls towards her neck due to gravity).

Lighting & Setting: Direct, harsh "Flash Photography". The flash illuminates her brightly against the dark night, casting sharp, crisp shadows of the chair and her body onto the textured dry sand below. The chair has colorful rainbow-striped fabric, adding a pop of nostalgic color.

Shot on an iPhone front-facing camera at 23mm, f/2.2, from a high-angle selfie perspective with shallow depth of field and soft bokeh. Finished with a VSCO C1 or G3-style filter — warm tones, slightly desaturated blacks, subtle film grain, low contrast — creating a dreamy, hazy, lazy Sunday morning atmosphere.

A detailed, structured prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate new profile images, header images, or smartphone wallpapers from a reference image. It allows users to specify the aspect ratio, add custom text as a logo, choose a logo design preset (cool, cute, luxury, etc.), control face zooming, and set the logo position, ensuring the generated image is suitable for various platforms like X (Twitter) or mobile devices.

### 示例图

![Nano Banana Pro Profile Image Generator with Aspect Ratio Control](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766667388735_ogado9_G8vcK3pbEAAyWBc.jpg)

![Nano Banana Pro Profile Image Generator with Aspect Ratio Control](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766667388526_s12xio_G8vchgibAAAY8zs.jpg)

![Nano Banana Pro Profile Image Generator with Aspect Ratio Control](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766667388900_elw308_G8vb0s0aEAE5u0V.jpg)

### 提示词

```
# ===== USER CONTROLS =====
aspect_ratio: "{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:1"}"          # examples: 3:1, 21:6, 16:9, 9:19.5, 2:1 ... (set any)
title_text: "{argument name="title text" default="<<YOUR_TEXT>>"}"
title_style_preset: "{argument name="logo style preset" default="cool"}"   # cool, cute, cool_cute, luxury, pop, cyber, minimal, retro, kawaii
face_zoom: "{argument name="face zoom" default="off"}"             # off, on
logo_position: "{argument name="logo position" default="right"}"       # up, down, left, right

subject: >
  Create a wide banner using the provided reference image content.
  The primary face must be centered, and a title logo (derived from title_text + title_style_preset)
  must be placed clearly in the composition.

composition: >
  Use the aspect ratio defined in USER CONTROLS (aspect_ratio).
  Keep important elements comfortably inside the frame with inner padding:
  - Keep the face and the title logo at least 15% away from the left/right edges.
  - Keep the face and the title logo at least 16% away from the top/bottom edges.
  Background may extend to the edges.

action: >
  Place the reference image content with maximum fidelity.
  Auto-crop/scale/reposition to fit the banner with no stretching.
  Detect the primary face (if multiple faces, pick the largest/most prominent).
  Center the primary
```

## 6748. Nano Banana Pro X Header Image Generation Prompt

- **id**：2972
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2972

### 描述

This is a detailed prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate an X (Twitter) header image based on a reference image. It includes a custom logo design based on user-specified text and a style preset, and offers options for face zooming to control the composition within a defined safe zone. It's an updated version of a previous prompt, focusing on practicality for profile image creation.

### 示例图

![Nano Banana Pro X Header Image Generation Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489525059_2o3mqx_G8uNoWzaAAA1VwE.jpg)

![Nano Banana Pro X Header Image Generation Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489525611_5q0gkx_G8uNocrboAAp-oB.jpg)

![Nano Banana Pro X Header Image Generation Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489525731_bqh21d_G8uNoWyaoAAOvlV.jpg)

![Nano Banana Pro X Header Image Generation Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489526547_e79955_G8uNoWzbIAAN3N7.jpg)

### 提示词

```
# ===== USER CONTROLS =====
title_text: "{argument name="display string" default="<<YOUR_TEXT>>"}"
title_style_preset: "{argument name="logo design preset" default="cool"}"  # cool, cute, cool_cute, luxury, pop, cyber, minimal, retro, kawaii
face_zoom: "{argument name="zoom on/off" default="off"}"            # off, on

subject: >
  Create a 3:1 wide banner using the provided reference image content.
  The primary face must be centered inside an invisible safe zone (not drawn),
  and a title logo (derived from title_text + title_style_preset) must be placed inside the same safe zone.

composition: >
  Aspect ratio 3:1.
  Invisible safe zone (DO NOT draw it):
  - Left margin: 15% of width
  - Right margin: 15% of width
  - Top margin: 16% of height
  - Bottom margin: 16% of height
  Keep the entire face AND the entire title logo fully inside this safe zone.
  Background may extend to the edges.

action: >
  Place the reference image content with maximum fidelity.
  Auto-crop/scale/reposition to fit a 3:1 banner with no stretching.
  Detect the primary face (if multiple faces, pick the largest/most prominent).
  Center the primary face within the safe zone both horizontally and vertically.
  Never crop off the face/eyes; keep the full face comfortably inside the safe zone (not near edges).

  Face zoom behavior:
  - If face_zoom is OFF: keep the original framing as much as possible while still centering the face in the safe zone.
  - If face_zoom is ON: zoom/crop to a bust-up portrait centered on the face
    (head and shoulders visible; include upper chest; do not crop the top of the head or chin; keep facial features prominent).

  Create negative space inside the safe zone for the title logo by adjusting crop/reposition/out
```

## 6759. Epic Figurative Art Prompt for 'Kanji of the Year'

- **id**：2984
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2984

### 描述

A highly detailed, multi-section prompt template designed for Nano Banana Pro to analyze a user's blog or profile (via a provided URL/screenshot) and generate an 'Epic Figurative Art' image. The image centers on a single Kanji character that symbolizes the user's entire year, with the strokes of the Kanji being composed of micro-objects representing their activities and memories. This prompt requires an input URL/screenshot for analysis.

### 示例图

![Epic Figurative Art Prompt for 'Kanji of the Year'](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489544894_85iyq4_G8tZ4scaQAAJtBE.jpg)

### 提示词

```
GENERAL STYLE & MOOD:
“Epic Figurative Art.” The prompt requires multi-layered analysis of the user’s provided home screen (articles, headings, used apps, notifications, colors) to condense all “elements” of the year into a single still image. It should be a fusion of philosophical, profound realism and surreal design.

TASK & ANALYSIS:
1. Comprehensively scan the text information within the provided home screen to extract frequently used vocabulary, interests, emotional fluctuations, and fragments of daily life.
2. Integrate these “total elements of the year” and select one ultimate “single Kanji character” that symbolizes the user’s journey.
3. Construct the “strokes” of that Kanji character as a three-dimensional collection of concrete events analyzed (e.g., work tools, hobby fragments, motifs from read articles).

SUBJECT:
The “single Kanji character” embodying the user’s year, centrally positioned.
- This character is a “collection of micro-stories.” Upon closer inspection, the parts of the character should be formed by specific objects that colored the user’s year (e.g., designs symbolizing specific news articles, daily tools, fragments of memory).
- Maintain perfect readability of the Kanji and ensure it has a strong skeletal structure.

ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND (The Total Year Narrative):
The background should also be depicted not merely as scenery, but as an epic panorama covering “all elements of the year.”
- Background composition: Behind the character, the analyzed events of the year should spread out as scenery, either chronologically or thematically (e.g., symbols of challenged projects, the atmosphere of visited places, images of engrossing news).
- Consistency: The central Kanji should be the core of the “world” of that year, with all background elements converging towards the character or overflowing from it.

LIGHTING & TEXTURE:
- Profound texture that conveys “layers of memory.” Metal, organic matter, light particles, and digital data should mix, possessing physically correct reflections and shadows.
- Background light sources (dramatic backlighting or sidelight) should illuminate the character, highlighting the multilayered elements of the year through shadow.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Accurately depict the Kanji shape (hooks, sweeps, stroke count) so it is correctly legible in Japanese.
- Arrange “elements of the year” in both the background and the character, ensuring the overall screen is not cluttered and maintains harmony as a single work of art.
- 4K high resolution. Completely exclude meaningless symbols, garbled text, or broken forms.

Input Information
[[ {argument name="input information" default="URL of your home screen/article here"} ]]
```

Lower-left (Sadness / Sadness):

Lower-right (Fun / Fun):

### 描述

A highly descriptive prompt for Gemini Nano Banana Pro to generate an ultra-realistic cinematic photograph with a film-still aesthetic. It requires strict facial likeness preservation from a reference photo, depicting a woman in a fur coat holding a glass of red wine, captured in a low-angle selfie against a snowy wooden mountain chalet background.

### 示例图

![Wintry Cinematic Selfie Prompt (Identity Locked)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489519282_zixfb8_G8rqML5bYAACEOt.jpg)

![Wintry Cinematic Selfie Prompt (Identity Locked)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766489519695_apjpvj_G8rqMKHbIAAYUan.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic photograph in a film-still aesthetic, based strictly on the face from the provided reference photo, preserving 100% facial likeness with absolutely no changes to facial structure or hair.
The image is captured as a low-angle selfie, with the camera slightly tilted upward, creating a dynamic perspective that emphasizes the grandeur of a wooden mountain chalet in the background, its roof heavily covered in snow. The upper lines of the building recede into perspective, enhancing the dramatic low-angle composition.
The woman is framed in a tight close-up. Her face is subtly tilted forward toward the camera, making her facial features appear more expressive: full lips, a clearly defined jawline, and balanced proportions. Her expression is calm and confident, with a soft, sensual half-smile.
She is wearing a voluminous, natural fluffy fur coat that fills the lower part of the frame due to the shooting angle. In her hand—raised slightly higher than usual because of the selfie perspective—she holds a large glass of red wine close to the camera, creating an almost three-dimensional effect. The wine has a deep ruby tone with cinematic softness, and gold rings are visible on her fingers.
Her straight hair is lightly dusted with snowflakes. Above her head, the sky and the chalet roof are visible, both densely covered in snow. Large snowflakes drift slowly through the air, appearing in both the foreground and background, adding depth and atmosphere.
Film look characteristics:
soft film grain;
pastel, slightly muted color palette;
gentle highlights on the glass and hair;
warm skin tones contrasting with cool bluish-gray hues of the snow and sky;
subtle vignette around the corners;
35mm film effect: smooth light transitions, natural shadows, no digital sharpness;
fine dust and microscopic film imperfections (optional).
The overall atmosphere is aesthetic, luxurious, relaxed, and wintry, evoking the feeling of a living cinematic moment and true presence in the scene.
```

action: >

  Center the primary face within the safe zone both horizontally and vertically.
  Never crop off the face/eyes; keep the full face comfortably inside the safe zone (not near edges).

  Face zoom behavior:

Her right hand is raised, with long manicured fingers delicately touching her cheek and jawline in a playful, posing gesture. Environment: The background features soft, floor-length beige or off-white sheer curtains, suggesting an indoor hotel room or bedroom setting at night. Lighting & Style: Warm, soft indoor lighting that creates gentle highlights on her hair and the silky texture of the shirt. (This provides a shallow depth of field, keeping her face and hand in sharp focus while softly blurring the texture of the curtains in the background). Shutter Speed: 1/60s or 1/100s. (Standard for indoor handheld shots to avoid motion blur). ISO: 400 to 800. (Slightly higher sensitivity to account for the warm, dim indoor lighting without introducing too much grain). Lighting Setup: Soft key light from the front-top (likely a ceiling fixture or ring light), creating the specular highlights on the nose and forehead.

## 6953. Victorian Gothic Royal Portrait Magazine Cover Prompt

- **id**：2732

### 描述

An extremely detailed, multi-section prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a 9:16 vertical, realistic magazine cover photo in a 'Victorian Gothic Royal' style. It requires 100% identity preservation from an uploaded face reference, specific heavy-duty Victorian court attire, London landmarks as the background, cinematic lighting, complex color matrix selection, and specific poses suitable for a magazine cover.

### 示例图

![Victorian Gothic Royal Portrait Magazine Cover Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766238189353_t1rx5n_G8diWGcakAckiYD.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Generate a 9:16 vertical, realistic photo of a "Victorian Gothic Royal" portrait: Use the uploaded FACE_REF as the character identity reference, 100% restoring the facial features and bone structure; the person is wearing heavy-duty court attire in the style of the "Victorian Era (19th Century) Court Gown" (corset, large crinoline, lace/velvet, royal jewelry), photographed next to the Tower Bridge or the Palace of Westminster (Big Ben) in London. The image should have photography, styling, and cover design quality comparable to 'Harper’s Bazaar', maintaining the magazine's consistent design style (Chinese and English design).

【INPUTS | Input】
FACE_REF: Uploaded facial feature reference image (identity lock)

【ABSOLUTE PRIORITY | Identity Lock (Highest Priority)】
100% restoration of FACE_REF's facial features and bone structure: Eye distance, nose bridge and wings, lip shape, jawline, and cheekbone structure must be completely consistent, with no deviation.
Realistic skin texture: Visible subtle textures and pores; avoid excessive smoothing or 'influencer' filters.
Adult female image (adult).

【SHOT TYPE | Two View Options (Model randomly selects one, must be realistic and consistent)】
A) Half-body cover: From the chest to above the waist, with jewelry, lace neckline, and eyes being the clearest (Primary recommendation)
B) Full-body cover: Complete presentation from head to toe, showing the full silhouette of the huge crinoline combined with the London landmark, strong perspective (Alternative)
(Regardless of A/B: Must maintain a "cover composition," with white space reserved for typography, but without torn paper/hand-drawn effects.)

【LOCATION | Scene (London, UK)】
London Landmark: By the River Thames, with the magnificent Gothic architecture of the Palace of Westminster (Big Ben) or the Tower of London Bridge in the background.
Weather option (random): 1) London Fog (classic foggy texture, soft and mysterious light) 2) Just after rain (wet ground reflection, lead-gray sky)
Clean background: No tourists, no modern signs, no mobile phone status bar UI, no watermarks or subtitles.

【LIGHTING & CAMERA | Photographic Quality (Magazine Grade)】
Lens feel: 85mm portrait quality (half-body) or 50mm/70mm (full-body), shallow depth of field, eyes are the sharpest.
Lighting: Overcast diffused light + dramatic fill light (emphasizing facial structure); diamonds/gems must have realistic fire; velvet texture must be deep.
Color: High-end cinematic feel, low-saturation blue-gray environment combined with the dark tones of the clothing (red/blue/black) to form a Gothic aesthetic; overall clean, transparent, and luxurious.

【WARDROBE | Victorian Court Gown (Heavy-duty, Sculpting, Intricate Details)】
Target aesthetic: "Wasp waist, large skirt, layered lace, heavy velvet, crown, queenly aura."

Silhouette and Layers (X-shaped tailoring)
Upper body: Highly structured corset, square or high neckline, puff sleeves or leg-of-mutton sleeves
Lower body: Huge crinoline or bustle, with noticeable stacking design at the back waist, skirt trailing on the ground
Decoration: Abundant ruffles, bows, dangling tassels
Fabric and Craftsmanship (Heavy craftsmanship must be "visible")
Main fabric: Heavy velvet, taffeta, Chantilly Lace
Main techniques: Beading, gold thread embroidery, ribbon weaving
Pattern themes: Damask, roses, thistle (symbol of Scotland), paisley pattern
Details: Lace gloves, neck ornament (Choker), medal/brooch
Headwear (Royal Jewelry Headpiece)
Core structure: Victorian small crown (Tiara) or feather headpiece
Decoration: Diamonds, sapphires, pearls
Earrings/Necklace: Extremely exaggerated diamond necklace, drop earrings

【COLOR MATRIX | Color Matrix Pairing (Must be executed, and must be "Royal Dark Colors")】
(Deep luxury of the late Victorian era)
Randomly select 1 set from the following three "Main Color Schemes" for the [Base Color/Large Area Main Fabric Color].

Scheme G (Royal Blue Base):
Base Color: Deep sapphire blue/midnight blue (velvet texture)
Embroidery/Decoration: Silver lace, diamonds, sapphires
Scheme A (Victorian Red Base):
Base Color: Wine red/Burgundy red (deep passion)
Embroidery/Decoration: Black lace, gold embroidery, rubies
Scheme R (Mourning Black Base):
Base Color: Ink black (Black Jet, extremely Gothic)
Embroidery/Decoration: Black beads, black lace, small amounts of gold or silver highlights

【Color Execution Rules】
Colors must be deep and rich, reflecting the majesty of the "Empire on which the sun never sets" and Gothic mystery.

【POSE | Cover Pose (Majestic, Stiff, Queenly Aura)】
Half-body: Chin slightly raised, cold gaze, one hand gently touching the necklace
Full-body: Standing tall (like a portrait painting), hands clasped on the crinoline, overwhelming presence
Expression: Serious, arrogant, imperious; absolutely no smiling (Victorian style).

【OUTPUT | Output】
1 vertical 9:16 realistic magazine cover photo
Random: Half-body or Full-body (A/B selection)
Random: Fog or Rain (Weather selection)
Random: Sapphire Blue / Wine Red / Ink Black (Color matrix selection)
Styling: Victorian court gown direction + Crown/Choker + Corset and large crinoline + Velvet and lace

## 6962. Polished Indoor Portrait with Shallow Depth of Field

- **id**：2609
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2609

### 描述

A detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic, polished portrait of a young Asian woman with glasses, seated in a leather armchair. The prompt specifies her outfit (pinstripe shirt dress, thigh-high stockings), pose (winking, hand near cheek), and precise camera settings (35mm/50mm, f/2.0-f/2.8) to achieve a shallow depth of field and warm indoor lighting.

### 示例图

![Polished Indoor Portrait with Shallow Depth of Field](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766237877154_k547uv_G8eHqWubcAAzZe_.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Subject: A photorealistic portrait of a young Asian woman with voluminous, long, wavy black hair and fair skin. She is wearing thin-rimmed, round glasses and has a playful expression, winking one eye with a subtle smile.
Outfit: She is dressed in a black, long-sleeved button-down shirt dress with thin white vertical pinstripes. She is wearing sheer black thigh-high stockings.
Pose: She is seated in a curved, cream-colored leather armchair. Her body is angled slightly forward. Her right hand is raised, with long manicured fingers delicately touching her cheek and jawline in a playful, posing gesture.
Environment: The background features soft, floor-length beige or off-white sheer curtains, suggesting an indoor hotel room or bedroom setting at night.
Lighting & Style: Warm, soft indoor lighting that creates gentle highlights on her hair and the silky texture of the shirt. High-resolution photography, sharp focus on the face, slightly candid but polished aesthetic.
Camera Angle: Slightly high angle (tilted down about 10–15 degrees), seated eye-level.
Focal Length: 35mm or 50mm. (This creates a natural perspective without too much distortion, typical of high-end smartphone portraits or standard portrait lenses).
Aperture: f/2.0 to f/2.8. (This provides a shallow depth of field, keeping her face and hand in sharp focus while softly blurring the texture of the curtains in the background).
Shutter Speed: 1/60s or 1/100s. (Standard for indoor handheld shots to avoid motion blur).
ISO: 400 to 800. (Slightly higher sensitivity to account for the warm, dim indoor lighting without introducing too much grain).
Lighting Setup: Soft key light from the front-top (likely a ceiling fixture or ring light), creating the specular highlights on the nose and forehead.
```

- **id**：2574
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2574

### 描述

A detailed prompt for generating a high-resolution studio photograph where the subject is posing in front of a large, stylized vector-art mural of themselves. The prompt emphasizes photographic realism, controlled cinematic lighting, and a clear distinction between the real subject and the painted mural, requiring a reference image for identity preservation.

### 示例图

![Personalized Mural Studio Portrait](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766237825336_lcrz0m_G8bGrc2aAAAdjzQ.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create a high-resolution studio photograph featuring THE_SUBJECT, using the uploaded photo as a strict visual reference for identity. THE_SUBJECT’s facial features, skin tone, body proportions, hairstyle, facial hair, and overall appearance must match the reference image exactly, with no reinterpretation or stylization of THE_SUBJECT. 

THE_SUBJECT is standing naturally and casually, leaning against a plain concrete or plaster studio wall. THE_SUBJECT is photographed as a real person in a real studio environment — this is a photographic image, not an illustration.

Painted directly onto the wall behind THE_SUBJECT is a large-scale mural depicting THE_SUBJECT’s face and upper body. The mural is a stylized vector-art portrait of THE_SUBJECT, clearly recognizable as the same person, rendered in bold graphic shapes, clean edges, and modern illustrative color blocking. The mural is significantly larger than life-size and occupies most of the wall surface.

THE_SUBJECT’s real body partially overlaps and obscures the mural, reinforcing depth and scale, while still making it immediately clear that the mural represents THE_SUBJECT. The mural must remain visibly painted on the wall, not floating, not projected, and not a digital overlay.

Lighting is controlled studio lighting with a cinematic feel: soft but directional, illuminating both THE_SUBJECT and the mural evenly, with subtle contrast and color separation that allows the real subject and the painted mural to coexist clearly in the same physical space.

The final image should feel like a professional studio portrait photographed in front of a custom mural wall — realistic, grounded, and visually cohesive — with a clear distinction between the real human subject and the stylized painted portrait behind them.
```

### 描述

A highly detailed prompt for Nano Banana Pro to convert characters in a reference image into watercolor illustrations of snowmen. It includes strict rules for the snowman's structure, the exclusion of human features, and the material rendering of the hair as pure white, compacted snow.

### 示例图

![Image-to-Snowman Conversion Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766237941688_na0hro_G8aiLeaakAICPKy.jpg)

![Image-to-Snowman Conversion Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766237941961_kdzr20_G8aiNluakAIuZjR.jpg)

### 提示词

```
# Describe the number, name, and appearance characteristics of the characters in the reference image here
[{argument name="Character Appearance" default="A girl wearing a cloak and a girl in a sailor uniform"}]

A watercolor illustration where all the above characters have transformed into cute “snowmen.”

Conversion Rules:
- The bodies of all characters will take the shape of a “snowman without limbs,” consisting of stacked white snowballs.
- The whole body is composed of 2 or 3 snowballs. Taller characters should have 3 segments.
- Eliminate human skin, limbs, and clothing details, making the body out of snow.
- To identify each character, only their characteristic “hats,” “ribbons,” and “image-colored buttons or scarves” should be attached to the snowman.
- The face should use simple snowman parts (black round eyes, orange or round nose).

★ Important Material Rule (Hair Correction):
- [Highest Priority] Hair parts must never be drawn as “human hair” or “wigs.”
- The shape of the hair is maintained, but the material is entirely “pure white snow mass.”
- Completely ignore the original character's hair color (such as black or brown) and express it in the snow's original “solid white (#FFFFFF).”
- Do not draw individual strands of hair; depict it as a “single mass” of compacted snow.
- Eliminate the boundary between the head snowball and the hairstyle part, integrating them like a single large snow sculpture.
- The texture should not be smooth but should have the “roughness” and “unevenness” characteristic of snow.
- The hair shape should be drawn as a “white silhouette” integrated with the snowman's head. The ends of the hair should not be sharp but rounded and plump, like melting snow.

Art Style:
- Analog-feeling watercolor painting.
- White drawing paper texture.
- Outlines are soft, and colors are pale and blurred.
- The background is white or a faint snowy landscape.
```

layering:

  detail_level: ultra_high_resolution
  micro_details: preserve_skin_texture_hair_edges_fabric_details

composition:

  layout: >
    Subject positioned on one side; headline text on the opposite side.
  emphasis: >
    Strong presence on the character's upper body and expression.

action:
  description: >

location:
  description: >
    Simple background created by interpreting the reference image’s mood.
    Use soft gradients, atmospheric glow, light particles, or abstract light rays.
    Avoid complex textures or any copyrighted shapes.
    Background must NOT contain any characters, silhouettes, faces, bodies,
    or blurred forms derived from the subject.
  background_feel: >
    Subtle, atmospheric, clean.
  allowed_elements: pure_color_gradients_light_abstract_shapes_only
  prohibit_subject_reuse_in_background: true

style:
  visual_style: >
    High-impact reveal-splash aesthetic with strong contrast between character and headline.
  text_effects: >
    Metallic, high-energy lettering with pronounced depth and perspective. No glow effects.
  character_rendering: >
    Extremely high-resolution rendering with sharp facial details, clean hair definition,
    precise edges, and crisp texture fidelity.
  background_style_rules: >
    Background must be purely non-figurative. No silhouettes, no blurred shapes,

  ink_splash_rules: >

camera_lighting:

  lighting: >

  clarity: maximum_definition

colors:
  palette: >
    Background colors inferred from the reference image.
    Character name in metallic silver; announcement text in saturated yellow.
  mood: dramatic, heroic, high_energy

text:
  character_name: "{argument name="character name" default="キャラクター名"}"
  announcement_fixed: "Participate!!"
  placement: opposite_side_of_character
  p

## 7213. Screen Time Digital Town Visualization Prompt

- **id**：2157
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2157

### 描述

A highly detailed, multi-section Chinese prompt for Nano Banana Pro that visualizes the user's screen time data as a miniature digital town (Isometric City). The prompt dictates the style (Polymer Clay/Jelly Resin), the structure (building height corresponds to usage time), the city's ecosystem (data flow, NPCs like mail carriers and like-sprites), and the final rendering specifications.

### 示例图

![Screen Time Digital Town Visualization Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991059784_oxoyti_G79xJJbbUAAZiy5.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Please read the user-uploaded [Screen Time Data Screenshot] and identify the top four APP names and icons. Retrieve information and icon styles for these APPs. Based on the tone of the APP combination (Social/Entertainment/Office/Comprehensive), independently decide on the core art style.

[2. Main Model Construction: Miniature Town Infrastructure] Construct a vibrant miniature digital town in the center of the screen, not just a display of buildings:

Smart Base (Foundation): A stylized mobile phone base. The surface is no longer flat but topographical (depending on the style, it could be rolling circuit board hills, glass water surfaces, or Lego baseplates).

Building Cluster (APP Embodiment): Skyscrapers representing the APPs.
Base: A cartoon-style smartphone base with rounded, frosted metal edges, and the screen surface emits a faint breathing light. The base is surrounded by floating, materialized 3D Emojis (clouds, stars, hearts) with a translucent jelly texture.
Building Cluster (APP Embodiment): Q-version skyscrapers stand on the island, representing the identified APPs.

Height Rule: Building height strictly corresponds to usage duration. The APP with the longest usage time is the tallest skyscraper, occupying the visual center.

Shape Rule: Extract the geometric features of the APP icons (e.g., circular icons become stacked spherical towers, square icons become rounded cube buildings).

Material: A mix of high-grade Frosted Polymer Clay and Translucent Jelly Resin. The surface should have delicate fingerprint textures and diffuse reflection gloss, like an expensive blind box toy.

Top Logo: The 3D logo of the App stands on the rooftop, with a texture like freshly baked, glossy candy.

Floating Time Card: A frosted glass-textured 3D bubble floats directly above the Logo. The bubble encapsulates three-dimensional, softly glowing numbers (corresponding to usage duration, such as "{argument name="usage duration" default="4h 12m"}").

Buildings should not be arranged in isolation but should form neighborhoods. Tall buildings are in the center (CBD area), surrounded by potentially low-rise system application buildings (Settings, Calendar, etc.).

[3. Urban Ecosystem and Interaction System (Urban Ecosystem & Interactions)] (Core Upgrade: Add “Interaction” and “Liveliness”) Please add rich dynamic details between the buildings to show how this “Digital Town” operates:

Traffic and Connection (The Data Flow):

Connection Method: Buildings must have physical connections.

Style Adaptation: If it's cyberpunk, use glowing fiber optic elevated bridges and maglev trains; if minimalist, use transparent glass pipes; if cute, use rainbow slides.

Vehicles and Transport: Pipes or roads must have flowing light points/capsules, representing data transmission.

Active “Data Sprites” (The Digital Citizens):

NPC Setting: Add tiny functional NPCs besides the main character figure.

Message Carriers: Near social APP buildings (like WeChat), flying paper airplane drones or small postmen carrying envelopes move in and out.

Like Sprites: Around video/community APP buildings (like Douyin/Xiaohongshu), glowing red hearts or thumb balloons float like fireflies.

Delivery/Shopping Riders: If Meituan/Taobao is present, there should be miniature riders or package conveyor belts connected to the main building where the protagonist is located.

Public Infrastructure (Public Utilities):

Wi-Fi Signal Tower: A glowing signal tower (shaped like a Wi-Fi icon) stands high in the town, broadcasting energy ripples across the city.

Battery Energy Station: A cylindrical energy tank (shaped like a battery icon) is located at the edge of the town, connected by thick cables to power the main building, where green liquid energy can even be seen sloshing.

Notification Airship: Small airships or clouds float in the air, hanging banners with “New Message” or “Red Dot.”

[4. Bottom Visual Center: Stylized 3D Nameplate] (Keep unchanged, emphasize high-end design sense)

Main Title Design: “SCREEN TIME” or “{argument name="main title" default="Today's Composition"}” are designed using Inflatable Typography or Neon Tube Fonts, with materials related to the current theme. They are not printed on paper but physically “stand” in the foreground of the image.

Decorative Details: Small 3D fragment elements (such as play buttons, like thumbs, battery icons) are scattered around the title, increasing the richness and trendy feel of the image.

Subtitle Copy: Below the 3D title, generate a floating glowing light strip with a short, sharp comment based on user data.

[5. Rendering and Photography (Tech Specs)]

Composition: Axonometric overhead view, emphasizing prosperity and order.

Details: Extremely rich Micro-details, making the viewer want to zoom in to see what the small figures are doing in every corner.

Keywords: Octane Render, C4D, Isometric City, Micro World, Living Ecosystem, 8k Resolution.
```

A vibrant, full-body shot, captured in a soft, vintage-style photograph, features a young woman with long, dark, wavy hair sitting casually on a wooden chair with metal legs. She wears a white t-shirt with a red graphic print layered under a full-length red jumpsuit with long sleeves, covering her from neck to toe. She still wears white knee-high lace socks with frilly tops and red sneakers with white logos for added retro charm. Her left leg is bent, with her foot resting on the chair, while her right leg extends forward.

Her makeup is distinctive, with heavily flushed pink cheeks and nose, winged eyeliner, and glossy lips. Small red bows sit in her hair, and her fingernails are painted blue. The background includes a light yellow wall and a window with a sheer white curtain. To her right, a vintage-style “Canister” jar sits on the windowsill. A plant is visible in the lower left corner. The lighting resembles a direct flash, creating bright, slightly harsh illumination on the subject, highlighting her skin and clothing textures while casting sharp shadows. The warm, saturated color grading gives the image a playful, retro, dreamy aesthetic reminiscent of grainy film photography.

Use photo reference for facial features.

A prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a realistic magazine cover based on a user-provided birth date. The AI analyzes major news and cultural trends from that period and designs a cover titled 'The Day I Was Born,' incorporating period-appropriate design styles, fonts, textures, and headlines.

### 示例图

![Magazine Cover Generation Based on Birth Date Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991078961_go8nq6_G78ZoUOa0AE9r14.jpg)

![Magazine Cover Generation Based on Birth Date Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991079186_5b8mie_G78ZjaMaQAA_qxq.jpg)

```
【Instruction Content】
Based on the user-inputted date, "The Day I Was Born ({argument name="birth date" default="1994/6/15"})," select 3 to 5 major news stories that were trending on or around that date, summarize the information including the culture and trends of that era, and generate a “general magazine cover image” laid out with that content as magazine headlines.

【Procedure (Your internal processing)】
1. Read the user's birth date and pick up multiple major news stories reported during that period.
2. Extract the design trends of that era (fonts, colors, paper quality, photo tone, layout).
3. Construct the magazine cover according to the design specifications below, and the final output should be only the image.

【Magazine Cover Design Specifications】
・Main Title: Must be "The Day I Was Born"
・Subtitle: A catchphrase that summarizes the year's character and historical background in one phrase
・The birth date (YYYY/MM/DD) must be placed on the cover
・Cover Composition:
　- The main visual is a photographic background symbolizing the era
　- Multiple extracted news stories are placed as magazine headlines
　- Trends of the time (music, movies, fashion, technology, etc.) are also made into auxiliary headlines
・Design Style:
　- Fonts, colors, photo graininess, and paper texture typical of a magazine from the birth year
　- Highly visible headline structure
・Text should be proofread into correct Japanese, and repeating the same sentence is prohibited
・Aspect Ratio: Vertical (Recommended 3:4)
・Quality: A realistic magazine cover with the texture of a printed material
```

The aesthetic is hyper-realistic, intimate, and beautifully festive—a private holiday moment of warm allure.

[CONTENT] = {argument name="Content" default="Sand flowing like liquid metal, small rusted gears, time flowing backward"}

## 7451. Enhanced Cinematic Noir Worm's-Eye View

- **id**：1436
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1436

### 描述

An extremely detailed, technical prompt for generating a cinematic neo-noir image using an extreme worm's-eye view from inside a drainage pipe. It meticulously describes the subject's appearance (Asian female, pixie cut, cat-eye sunglasses, vinyl bomber jacket), accessories (silver rings, dragon tattoo), composition (forced perspective, splayed fingers), lighting (sodium-vapor, volumetric fog, teal & orange grading), and camera/post-processing specs.

### 示例图

![Enhanced Cinematic Noir Worm's-Eye View](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765440101180_tpohe9_G7u-y_ka0AAr1AV.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Subject & Wardrobe: A striking Asian female with a razor-sharp jet-black pixie cut (textured with pomade, asymmetrical fringe grazing her right brow), sporting matte-black oversized cat-eye sunglasses (acetate frames with micro-scratches). Her fingers are adorned with 5 silver rings: a skull signet, a serpent coil, a geometric cube, a band with etched runes, and a cracked obsidian stone. She wears a crimson vinyl bomber jacket (high-gloss, ribbed cuffs), collar popped, catching the backlight like liquid fire. Beneath, a sleeveless mesh top reveals a dragon tattoo creeping up her forearm. 

Camera & Perspective: Extreme worm's-eye view shot from inside a drainage pipe (circular, 18-inch diameter), lens positioned 6 inches above the wet ground. Forced perspective distortion makes her hand a monumental, terrifying presence—fingers elongated, knuckles massive, veins bulging. The circular frame vignettes the image, creating a keyhole peep-show effect. 

Action & Composition: She leans forward aggressively, weight on her right leg, left knee bent, creating a dynamic diagonal thrust through the frame. Her right hand lunges toward camera, fingers splayed, index finger extended, casting a shadow that eclipses the dice. Her face is 3/4 obscured by the sunglasses and hair; only her pierced lower lip (silver hoop) and clenched jaw are visible, exuding predatory focus. 

Surface & Dice: The ground is rain-slicked asphalt with iridescent oil slicks (cyan, magenta, gold). 12 translucent red casino dice (precision-edged, pips glowing like embers) are scattered in chaotic abandon—some stacked, some mid-roll. Water beads cling to them, refracting light. A single die is caught in sharp focus in the extreme foreground, magnified by the lens. 

Lighting & Atmosphere: Dense fog backlit by a single sodium-vapor streetlight (5700K, creating a hellish orange aura). Volumetric light rays pierce the fog, haloing her jacket. Low-key lighting: deep shadows dominate, with rim lighting outlining her silhouette in molten red. A subtle cyan bounce from the wet surface creates chilling color contrast. Lens flare: anamorphic horizontal streaks and circular bokeh orbs. 

Technical Specs: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, 12mm Laowa Probe Lens (f/2. 8, 1/1000s shutter), 8K resolution, ISO 6400 for grit. Deep focus from foreground die to her face. Cinematic aspect ratio: 2. 39:1 (though can be cropped to 4:5). Shot in Log-C, graded with Teal & Orange + Neon Noir LUT. 

Post-Processing: Chromatic aberration on high-contrast edges, film grain (Kodak 500T emulation), micro-contrast sharpening on rain droplets. Color grading: crushed blacks, lifted shadows, hyper-saturated reds, desaturated skin tones. Subtle vignette from the pipe's darkness. 

Mood & Narrative: Neo-noir tension — a high-stakes underground gamb
```

### 描述

A complex, multi-part system prompt for Nano Banana Pro Agent V1.2 to create a 'Head-top Diorama' image, where the character's head or hat serves as the base for a miniature, fantastical scene. This specific example focuses on an afro/voluminous hair interpreted as a cloud amusement park. This is a duplicate of tweet 1998335885985669354.

### 示例图

![Head-top Diorama Prompt for Nano Banana Pro Agent V1.2 (Afro/Cloud Amusement Park)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765440119604_drtqhu_G7t-WEdbQAEX-e_.jpg)

### 提示词

```
You are a **"Miniature Set Designer and Portrait Photographer" who constructs fantastical worlds.** Deeply analyze the content of the input text provided at the end, and generate an image of an **elaborate and narrative "Head-top Diorama"** developed using the person's head (or hat) as a base.

At that time, place the character from the attached reference image as the **"wearer (the base person)"** of the diorama. Maintain the consistency of the character's facial features and identity (ID) while depicting a natural expression suited to the weight and atmosphere of the scene on their head.

▼ Instructions for Generation Process (Thinking Process)
Utilize Nano Banana Pro's inference capability and execute the following thinking process before drawing:

1. **[Step 1: World Scaling]**: Select elements to condense the theme specified in the input text (city, forest, factory, etc.) to hat size.
2. **[Step 2: Boundary Fusion]**: Logically design how the brim of the hat or the hair physically connects to the ground of the diorama (coastline, cliff, floor).
3. **[Step 3: Micro-Lighting]**: Simulate what kind of shadows (Cast Shadow) the light sources within the diorama (streetlights, bonfire, magical light) cast on the wearer's face.

▼ Design and Style Specification
* **Composition/Layout**: Bust-up portrait. The camera is slightly high-angle (俯瞰) to show details on the head. Shallow depth of field (DoF), focusing on the diorama part and blurring the background to emphasize the miniature feel (Tilt-Shift effect).
* **Taste**: Photorealistic, macro photography, fantastical, cinematic lighting.
* **Text**: Accurately draw text symbolizing the theme (e.g., "{argument name="sign text 1" default="跡地"}", "{argument name="sign text 2" default="Cafe"}", etc.) in natural fonts, in Japanese or English, on signs or markers placed within the diorama.
* **Character**: The reference character is either quietly closing their eyes or posing as if looking up to feel the world on their head.

▼ Input Text
[Afro/Voluminous Hair × Cloud Amusement Park]
**Goal:** Interpret the hair's "fluffiness" as "clouds" to construct a fancy world.
> **Input Text:**
> キャラクターのボリュームのある髪（アフロやカーリーヘア）を、ピンク色の夕焼け雲に見立てた「天空の遊園地」のジオラマ。

### 描述

A prompt designed to create a visual illusion where a man's torso is replaced by a rectangular wooden frame, and the background visible inside the frame seamlessly continues the environment outside it, making his body appear invisible in that section.

### 示例图

![Illusion Image: Invisible Torso Cut-Out](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765440097834_yl1er3_G7tzN_dbgAAltMQ.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A man in casual clothes seated on the wooden slat of a park bench in a sunny city park, holding a rectangular wooden frame at chest level. Only parts visible are his face above the frame, his forearms and hands gripping the frame’s edges, and his legs below the frame, resting naturally on the ground. Inside the frame, instead of his torso, the park background continues seamlessly, showing grass, trees, and pathways as if his body is invisible. The frame acts like a cut-out window where his torso should be, perfectly aligned with the background. The park scenery inside the frame must match the environment outside it in an uncanny way, with precise continuity of bench, ground, and distant trees, while the edges of the frame stay clearly defined.
```

On the left side ({Era_A}): show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. ### 描述

This is a highly structured, JSON-formatted prompt designed for the Gemini Nano Banana Pro image generation tool. It specifies a complete pipeline sequence for creating an 'Evening Festival Portrait' image, including detailed settings for subject identity preservation (using an attached image buffer), kinematics control (OpenPose), wardrobe assembly, environment staging (Outdoor Night Market), and lighting setup. It's useful for users who want precise control over every aspect of the generated image, especially when starting from a reference photo.

### 示例图

![Detailed JSON-based Image Generation Prompt for Gemini Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765421881613_93k8ge_G7mkfbYWsAAwcGt.jpg)

### 提示词

```
{
    "pipeline_sequence_v5": {
      "global_settings": {
        "project_name": "EVENING_FESTIVAL_PORTRAIT",
        "render_target": {
          "width": 1080,
          "height": 1920,
          "ratio": "9:16"
        },
        "seed_strategy": "Fixed",
        "steps": 50
      },

      "node_01_subject_initialization": {
        "module": "Identity_Preservation",
        "parameters": {
          "source_input": "Attached_Image_Buffer",
          "face_restore_strength": 1.0,
          "feature_lock": {
            "eyes": "Strict",
            "nose": "Strict",
            "mouth": "Strict",
            "skin_texture": "Blend_with_Prompt"
          }
        },
        "morphology": {
          "hair": {
            "style": "{argument name="hair style" default="Long_Wavy"}",
            "color": "{argument name="hair color" default="Brown"}",
            "physics": "Natural_Soft"
          },
          "makeup": {
            "lips": "{argument name="lip color" default="Soft_Natural_Pink"}",
            "finish": "Dewy",
            "intensity": "Natural_Glow"
          }
        }
      },

      "node_02_kinematics_control": {
        "module": "ControlNet_OpenPose",
        "pose_skeleton": {
          "body_orientation": "Standing",
          "spine_curve": "Slight_Lean_Back",
          "right_arm": {
            "state": "Relaxed_Down"
          },
          "left_arm": {
            "state": "Relaxed_Down"
          },
          "head_vector": {
            "pitch": 0,
            "yaw": 10,
            "target": "Lens_Direct"
          }
        }
      },

      "node_03_wardrobe_assembly": {
        "module": "Layered_Clothing_Generator",
        "layers": [
          {
            "layer_id": 1,
            "item": "{argument name="clothing item" default="Sleeveless Crop Top"}",
            "pattern": "{argument name="clothing pattern" default="Floral_Oriental"}",
            "color_palette": "{argument name="color palette" default="Navy_Orange_Green"}",
            "fit": "Fitted"
          },
          {
            "layer_id": 2,
            "item": "Accessories",
            "elements": [
              { "type": "Necklace", "style": "Layered_Gold_Choker" },
              { "type": "Earrings", "style": "Small_Drop" }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },

      "node_04_environment_stage": {
        "module": "Scene_Builder",
        "setting_type": "{argument name="setting type" default="Outdoor_Night_Market"}",
        "assets": {
          "lighting_decor": "Hanging_Warm_String_Lights",
          "background_elements": "Plants_Shops_People",
          "ground_material": "Soft_Dirt"
        },
        "atmosphere": {
          "mood": "Warm_Festive_Evening",
          "clutter_density": "Medium_Lively"
        }
      },

      "node_05_lighting_engine": {

        "setup": {

          "fill_light": "Ambient_Night_Soft",

## 7663. Hāng to Lā (Good to Bad) Rating Infographic Prompt

- **id**：1993
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1993

### 描述

A complex Chinese prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate a 'Hāng to Lā' (Good to Bad) rating infographic using a Bento Grid layout. It instructs the AI to research a user-specified topic (e.g., 2025 Chinese New Energy Vehicles) and visually categorize the results into five distinct levels, from 'Hāng' (Top Tier, explosive red/gold) to 'Lā' (Worst Tier, desperate black/white with glitch effects), requiring specific product names for the lower tiers.

### 示例图

![Hāng to Lā (Good to Bad) Rating Infographic Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991064618_xxgmro_G7lPFb4bwAAh_6b.jpg)

### 提示词

```
[Core Task Instruction]
You are an AI expert with real-time web search capabilities and top-tier data visualization design skills. Please perform the following two steps:
Research Phase: Immediately conduct comprehensive online research on the user-specified [{argument name="research target field" default="2025 Chinese New Energy Vehicles"}]. Collect public reputation, market popularity, professional reviews, and user feedback data on different sub-products, models, or works within this field.

Visualization Phase: Based on your research results, design a professional Infographic. You need to accurately classify and fill the specific projects researched into the five visual level modules defined below, ranging from “Hāng” to “Lā” (Good to Bad).

[User Specified Target Field/Product]
[{argument name="target field" default="Fill in the content you need to research here, e.g., Popular smartphones in 2024, Sugar-free tea beverage brands on the market, Marvel movies of the last decade, Code editors commonly used by programmers"}]

[Image Design Requirements]
Overall Style:
A modular infographic with clear structure and a strong modern feel, using a “Bento Grid” layout. The background should be clean and simple, focusing on content presentation. Visually, it must show a strong hierarchical drop-off from high to low.

Level Structure and Visual Definition (Strictly enforce the following five levels):

Level 1 (Highest Level): 夯 (Hāng - Top Tier)
Research Filling Standard: According to research, the generally recognized “Version King” in the field, with dominant popularity and undisputed top-tier products/works.

Visual Representation: Occupies the topmost or largest module on the screen. The color scheme is explosive burst red and glorious gold, with visual effects like halos or energy overflow. The font is the largest and boldest. The module must display the names or high-quality images of the representative products researched, accompanied by minimalist phrases of praise (e.g., “Blown up across the internet,” “Masterpiece”).

Level 2: Top Tier

Research Filling Standard: Hardcore powerhouses, whose reputation may not be as high as “Hāng,” but are highly praised and are the preferred high-quality projects for experts.

Visual Representation: Located on the second layer. The color scheme is solid, high-end burning orange and metallic silver. The module design appears robust and textured. Display representative powerhouse products.

Level 3: Superior

Research Filling Standard: Superior choices, tasteful, solid middle ground that is definitely worth buying/watching, representing a certain level of connoisseurship.

Visual Representation: Located in the middle layer. The color scheme is bright, clean lemon yellow and cool gray. The design style is modern and refreshing. Display representative high-quality middle-class products.

Level 4: NPC

Research Filling Standard: Generic products with no memory points, mass-produced industrial products, neither good nor bad, easily forgotten. Must include specific product or brand names, do not be vague.

Visual Representation: Located in the lower-middle layer. The color scheme is dull and bland bread color/beige or cardboard brown. The module design appears ordinary, repetitive, and lacks personality. Display those very mediocre products.

Level 5 (Bottom Level): 拉完了 (Lā - Failed)

Research Filling Standard: Recognized “landmines,” “IQ taxes,” disastrous failed products found in the research, or even products that are worse than nothing. Must include specific product or brand names, do not be vague.

Visual Representation: Squeezed into the bottom or corner of the screen, with compressed visual space. The color scheme is desperate black, pale white, and features obvious digital glitch, fragmentation, or decay visual effects. Display those famous “flop” products, accompanied by warning phrases (e.g., “Run away,” “Big sucker”).
```

```
You are a **photo essayist and graphic designer who records lifestyle**. Based on the input text (and attached image) provided at the end, please generate a **“multi-cut scrapbook-style image that captures the memory of a fun meal.”**

At that time, please include the character from the attached reference image, positioned as **“stickers or cut-out photos that accent the album,”** and assign them a **role (such as posing as if saying 'Itadakimasu' or commenting in a corner)**.

▼ Instructions for the Generation Process (Thinking Process)
Utilize Nano Banana Pro's reasoning ability and execute the following thought process before drawing:

1.  **[Step 1: Scene Expansion and Diversification]**: Imagine (simulate) multiple cuts that convey a story from the single input image of the “pot of food.”

2.  **[Step 2: Album Composition Design]**: Set the background to a “wooden table” or “kraft paper,” and arrange the 3-4 photos above randomly and balanced in a Polaroid or bordered photo style.
3.  **[Step 3: Decoration and Handwritten Text]**: Place masking tape, clips, and handwritten-style Japanese comments (“Great!”, “Delicious,” etc.) and a date around the photos to complete a DIY-style album.

▼ Design and Style Specification

    * Decorative text like “Yummy!” or “Recipe Memo” next to the photos.
* **Character**: Process the reference character into a “sticker style” or “photo cut-out style” and depict them as if they are pasted onto the album page.

▼ Input Text
